* **Review \& Verification:** Check drawings for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to industry standards.
* **Manufacturing Support:** Communicate with production teams to create layouts and assist with testing, ensuring designs translate well to manufacturing.
* **File Management:** Maintain electronic databases of drawings and related documents

* Proficiency in CAD software (AutoCAD, SolidWorks).
* Strong understanding of 3D modeling and technical drawing principles.

* Knowledge of materials, manufacturing processes, and engineering fundamentals.
* Problem\-solving and attention to detail.

. Design KPIs, appraisal frameworks and promotion guidelines tailored to hospitality operations.

. Coach managers on performance conversations and team management.

title: HR Generalist
description:
**About Flexport:**
-------------------



At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That's why it's our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We're shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.



The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

**About the role**
------------------



We're looking for an experienced HR Generalist, based in Mumbai, to own the full employee lifecycle and people programs across India and the Subcontinent. This is a true generalist role: you'll run recruiting end to end, manage onboarding through offboarding, and drive the HR operations, compliance, and employee\-experience work that keeps our teams thriving. You'll be the local face of the APAC People team, making sure our ambitious growth is supported by a robust and effective people strategy. We're building a People function that works smarter with AI, so you'll be encouraged to use modern AI\-powered tools to automate manual work, sharpen sourcing, and free up more time for the human side of HR.


**What You'll do**
------------------


* Own full\-cycle recruiting for a range of roles across departments—building search strategies, sourcing active and passive candidates, screening, interviewing, and guiding candidates through hiring and onboarding.
* Track sourcing data to focus effort on the channels with the highest ROI, and partner closely with hiring managers to attract, assess, and close top talent.
* Drive proactive recruiting initiatives and help build the Flexport employer brand across the region.
* Communicate candidate pipelines, funnel metrics, and performance data clearly and regularly to internal stakeholders.
* Serve as the local representative of the APAC People team, enhancing employee experience across the full lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding.
* Lead local HR operations including data management, employee support, reporting and analytics, process improvement, payroll support, and policy development.
* Maintain accurate HRIS data in Workday, run audits, and resolve employee tickets.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools to automate repetitive HR tasks, source and screen candidates faster, and surface insights from people data.
* Act as the local expert on HR policy and ensure HR compliance across the region.
* Take on additional projects from the global and regional People leadership team as needed.

**What You'll bring**
---------------------


* A BA/BS degree and 6\+ years of experience, including full\-cycle recruiting at a search firm or fast\-growing company.
* A strong track record of processing a wide range of HR transactions and a solid understanding of HR best practices across the APAC region.
* Proven ability to build rapport with hiring managers and cross\-functional partners at all levels.
* A creative approach to finding great people, with the ability to build candidate networks and channel connections.
* A drive for results—you see processes through end to end and are motivated by data and metrics.
* Humility: no task is too big or too small.
* Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
* Hands\-on experience with Workday (HCM, recruiting, or reporting) is strongly preferred.
* Comfort adopting AI\-powered HR and recruiting tools, with curiosity about how AI can make people processes faster and better.

#### **Commitment to Equal Opportunity**



At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


#### **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants**



Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

title: HR Manager
description:
We are a growing multi\-business group based in Madurai employing over 300 people. We are looking for an experienced Chief HR Manager to own the complete HR function across all our business units.

This is a senior, independent role. You will report directly to management and will be responsible for building and running HR systems, ensuring statutory compliance, processing payroll, designing performance frameworks, and developing our workforce. We need someone who can operate with minimal supervision and takes full ownership.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Recruitment \& Onboarding:**

* End\-to\-end hiring across all business units — sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding
* Design and maintain induction process and probation tracking for all new joiners

**Payroll \& Compensation:**

* Monthly payroll processing for 100\+ employees across all units
* Salary structure design, advance and loan tracking, and full and final settlement
* Coordinate with accounts team for disbursement and ledger entries

**Statutory Compliance:**

* ESI and PF — monthly challan, employee registration, and claim coordination
* Professional Tax, Gratuity, and Bonus compliance
* Labour law compliance — Factories Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, Minimum Wages Act
* Maintain statutory registers and ensure readiness for labour inspections at all times

**KPI \& KRA Framework:**

* Design and implement KRA and KPI frameworks for every role across all businesses
* Conduct quarterly performance reviews and compile reports for management
* Manage performance improvement plans for underperforming employees

**Training \& Development:**

* Identify training needs and design quarterly training calendars
* Deliver induction training for new joiners and coordinate external programs
* Build and maintain a skills matrix for the entire workforce

**Employee Relations:**

* Handle grievances, disciplinary matters, and exit interviews
* Maintain a positive work culture and manage attrition proactively

**HR Reporting:**

* Monthly HR MIS report to management — headcount, compliance status, attrition, training
* Maintain all employee records digitally — contracts, documents, performance history

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Mandatory:**

* MBA (HR) / MSW / PGDHRM or equivalent qualification
* 7–12 years of HR experience with at least 4 years in a manufacturing or industrial environment
* Hands\-on payroll processing experience for 100\+ employee headcount
* Strong knowledge of ESI, PF, Factories Act, and Tamil Nadu labour laws
* Proven experience designing and implementing KRA and KPI frameworks
* Proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets
* Strong Tamil communication; working English for documentation

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience managing HR across multiple business units simultaneously
* Familiarity with HRMS software — Zoho People, GreytHR, or similar
* Training facilitation experience — ability to conduct sessions independently

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Senior leadership role with full ownership of the HR function
* Exposure to HR management across three distinct industries
* Direct reporting to and visibility with senior management
* Stable, long\-term employment with a well\-established business group
* Performance\-based salary revision annually

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.

title: Senior Benefits Analyst
description:
**About the team**
------------------

The Senior Benefits Analyst will be an integral operational partner to the U.S.\-based Benefits Team. Based in India, this role supports the accurate, compliant, and efficient delivery of our benefits programs — from day\-to\-day administration and employee support to data integrity, compliance, and reporting.
  

You will also partner closely with the Benefits Program Managers to support benefits administration across our locations\- U.S, Mexico, India, Germany, Canada, and Serbia. This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role within our GCC and an opportunity to grow deep expertise in global benefits operations.
**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.


**About the role**
------------------

### **Benefits Administration**

* Administer employee benefits programs across health, welfare, retirement, and ancillary plans, ensuring accuracy and a positive employee experience.
* Process enrollment transactions, qualifying life events, and employee data changes in the HRIS; partner with carriers and vendors to resolve discrepancies.
* Serve as a Tier 3 resource for employee benefits inquiries, providing clear and timely guidance on plan provisions, eligibility, and enrollment processes.
* Assist with benefits billing processes, including data validation and submission support; U.S. team retains payment authorization.
* Partner with the Global Benefits Program Manager to support international benefits administration across multiple countries, including enrollment coordination, billing reconciliation, and carrier data management.
* Support routine plan administration tasks for international programs, including data pulls, eligibility tracking, and audit support.

### **Compliance \& Audit**

* Support the preparation and coordination of recurring U.S. benefits compliance obligations, including annual filings, regulatory reporting, and plan documentation.
* Execute a portfolio of recurring data audits across benefit programs to ensure enrollment accuracy, eligibility integrity, and data quality.
* Prepare audit documentation, organize supporting materials, and manage audit checklists; escalate findings and flag discrepancies to the U.S. team for resolution.
* Monitor ongoing compliance obligations and proactively surface issues to the appropriate U.S. owner.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
**Who you are**
---------------

* Detail\-oriented and process\-driven. You take ownership of complex, multi\-step processes and execute them with precision and consistency.
* Proactive and accountable. You identify issues before they become problems, escalate clearly with documented findings, and follow through to resolution.
* Collaborative. You work seamlessly across time zones, building trust with U.S. counterparts through reliable communication and dependable follow\-through.
* Analytically minded. You’re comfortable working with data across HRIS and vendor platforms — pulling reports, spotting anomalies, and organizing findings clearly.
* Effective in Cloud HQ. You thrive in a remote, asynchronous environment, communicate clearly in writing, and build trust without in\-person presence.
* Curious about the ‘why’. You want to understand the context behind the work, not just complete tasks — and you ask questions when something doesn’t add up.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 4\+ years of experience in benefits administration, HR operations, or a related field
* Experience administering health, welfare, and/or retirement benefit programs
* Familiarity with benefits compliance concepts and regulatory obligations is a strong plus
* Experience supporting global or international benefits programs preferred
* Proficiency with Workday or a comparable HRIS; comfortable running reports and processing benefit transactions
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for data reconciliation and reporting
* Excellent written communication skills in English; able to communicate clearly with employees, vendors, and global counterparts
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, asynchronous, remote environment

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers.


As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., Zillow helps millions of customers navigate buying, selling, financing, and renting with greater ease and confidence. Our teams in India play a critical role in building and scaling the technology, products, and operations that power this experience.


Whether you’re working in tech, operations, or shared services, you’ll collaborate with global partners to solve meaningful problems and help more people make home a reality.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, maternity status, HIV status, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to candidates with disabilities, in accordance with applicable policies.*

description:
**About the Role**

Our client is a Bengaluru\-based leadership development firm that designs and delivers flagship, high\-touch learning journeys for frontline and mid\-level managers of leading enterprise organisations. These are outcome\-driven, high\-ticket programs sold to senior HR decision\-makers — not off\-the\-shelf training.

We are looking for a refined, articulate senior sales professional who has already sold HR / L\&D / training solutions to enterprise clients, and who can hold a credible, consultative conversation with CHROs, HR Heads, L\&D Heads, and OD leaders — connecting the cost of untrained managers to business outcomes, generating qualified opportunities, and carrying them through to closure.

**Who This Role Is For (Read Before Applying)**

**This is a specialist role. We will only consider candidates who meet ALL of the following:**

* **Enterprise HR/L\&D solution sales experience.** A minimum of 3 years selling L\&D, leadership development, corporate training, talent development, HR consulting, or assessment solutions to enterprise or large mid\-market organisations. Your CV must name the solutions you sold and the buyer personas you sold to.
* **Direct experience selling to HR / L\&D / OD leadership.** You have personally prospected into, and held consultative discovery conversations with, CHROs, HR Heads, L\&D Heads, and OD leaders — and can speak to specific accounts and conversations in an interview.
* **Full\-cycle ownership.** You have both generated qualified opportunities AND closed them, ideally high\-ticket services (₹10L\+ engagements) with 4–12 week sales cycles. A purely SDR / appointment\-setting background does not qualify.
* **Polished communication.** Excellent spoken and written English; poised, articulate, and credible in CXO\-level conversations.
* **Tool fluency.** Hands\-on with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, email outreach tools, and a CRM (HubSpot / Zoho / Salesforce or similar).

**This role is NOT a fit if your experience is primarily in:** B2C / edtech counselling sales, telesales or telecalling, recruitment / staffing BD, generic IT or SaaS sales without HR/L\&D buyer exposure, or pure lead\-generation / SDR roles. Applications from these backgrounds will not be processed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Prospecting \& Pipeline Generation**

* Build and maintain a targeted database of CHROs, HR Heads, L\&D Heads, and OD leaders across priority industries and enterprise accounts.
* Run structured outbound campaigns (calls, email sequences, LinkedIn outreach, nurture mailers) using program\-specific messaging and research\-backed insights such as manager\-effectiveness data and cost\-of\-inaction framing.
* Follow up on inbound enquiries, webinar/event registrants, and marketing\-generated leads promptly and professionally.

**Consultative Conversations \& Qualification**

* Engage senior HR stakeholders in discovery conversations: understand their manager\-capability challenges, current L\&D initiatives, budgets, and decision processes.
* Position the firm’s flagship manager\-development programs in the context of the client’s business problem — attrition, first\-time\-manager transitions, engagement, leadership pipeline — rather than as generic training.

title: Export Sales Intern
description:
**Company:** Handmada  
**Location:** Rajkot/Morbi, Gujarat, India  
**Department:** International Sales \& Business Development  
**Reports To:** Export Sales Manager  
**Team:** Works alongside other Export Sales Executives; may mentor Export Sales Interns

About Handmada

Handmada is a global supply group based in Morbi, India, combining manufacturing experience with carefully managed supplier partnerships across tiles, SPC, ceramic fiber \& brick, FIBC bags, slabs, sanitary ware, rope, cotton, brass products, kitchen sinks, API, and aluminium bottles. We work with importers, distributors, and project developers across international markets who expect consistency, accountability, and clear communication in every transaction.

Role Overview

We're looking for an **Export Sales Executive** to manage international buyer relationships across one or more of Handmada's product categories or regions. You'll own the full sales cycle — from qualifying an inbound inquiry to closing the order, coordinating with QC and production, and following through to shipment.

This is a hands\-on, buyer\-facing role. You'll be on calls with importers in the US, Europe, GCC, and beyond, negotiating terms, solving problems, and building the kind of trust that turns a one\-time order into a repeat account. You'll report to the Export Sales Manager and work closely with the documentation, QC, and production teams.

Key ResponsibilitiesSales \& Client Management

* Respond to inbound inquiries from international buyers promptly and professionally, understanding their requirements before quoting
* Prepare and send accurate quotations, proforma invoices, and product specifications based on buyer needs
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery timelines within approved margin and policy guidelines
* Follow up consistently on open quotations and pending decisions without being pushy — know when to push and when to give space
* Own the full order lifecycle: confirmation, coordination with production/QC, documentation handoff, and shipment tracking
* Proactively update buyers on order status, delays, or changes — never let a client find out about a problem on their own
* Build long\-term relationships with existing accounts to encourage repeat orders and referrals

Coordination \& Execution

* Liaise with the QC team to confirm buyer specifications are understood and met before dispatch
* Coordinate with the documentation team to ensure invoices, packing lists, and certificates are accurate and on time
* Flag any recurring buyer complaints or spec mismatches to the Export Sales Manager for resolution
* Maintain accurate and updated records of all leads, quotations, and orders in the CRM

Market \& Product Knowledge

* Develop strong working knowledge of assigned product categories — specifications, pricing logic, lead times, and common buyer objections
* Stay updated on market pricing trends, competitor activity, and shifts in buyer demand within assigned regions
* Represent Handmada at trade shows, buyer meetings, or virtual demos as required

Team Contribution

* Share market feedback and buyer insights with the Export Sales Manager to help refine pricing and positioning
* Support the onboarding of new Export Sales Interns by sharing product knowledge and answering questions when asked
* Contribute to a team culture of accountability, responsiveness, and follow\-through

Required Qualifications

* 1\-3 years of experience in international sales, export sales, or B2B sales (freshers with strong communication skills and a relevant degree may also be considered for a junior track)
* Bachelor's degree in Business, International Trade, Marketing, or a related field
* Working knowledge of export basics — incoterms, LC processes, and shipping documentation is a strong plus, but can be trained
* Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages (Spanish, Arabic, French) are an advantage
* Comfortable using CRM tools, Excel/Google Sheets, and email/WhatsApp for professional client communication

Key Skills

* **Clear, confident communication** — able to explain specs, pricing, and terms to buyers from different cultures and time zones without confusion
* **Negotiation instinct** — knows when to hold firm on price and when flexibility earns a long\-term client
* **Ownership mindset** — treats every order as their responsibility from inquiry to delivery, not just "my part of it"
* **Organized follow\-through** — nothing falls through the cracks; quotations, follow\-ups, and documentation stay on track
* **Problem\-solving under pressure** — when something goes wrong (a delay, a spec issue), stays calm and finds a solution instead of passing blame
* **Curiosity about the product** — genuinely learns the categories they sell instead of reading off a spec sheet

What We're Looking For (Beyond the Resume)

We want someone who treats every buyer conversation like it matters — not someone chasing a quick close and moving on. You should be the kind of person who:

* Follows up because you actually want the deal to work for both sides, not just to hit a number
* Double\-checks a quotation before sending it, because a wrong number damages trust
* Can tell a buyer "that's not something we do well" instead of overselling
* Wants to understand what you're selling well enough to answer hard questions confidently

Compensation \& Benefits

* Competitive fixed salary \+ performance\-based incentive on closed orders
* Direct exposure to international buyers, trade shows, and cross\-border negotiation
* Clear growth path toward Senior Export Sales Executive or Export Sales Manager roles as you build a track record
* On\-the\-job training in export documentation, pricing, and multi\-category product knowledge

How to Apply

Interested candidates should send their resume along with a short note on their sales experience to **husain@handmada.in**, or reach out directly at **\+91 94294 84412**.

Pay: ₹8,192\.77 \- ₹21,673\.75 per month

title: Voice Diarization Engineer (Top Pay) — Startup Rebuilding the AI Notetaker Around Rules of Privilege
description:
**Voice Diarization Engineer (Top Pay) —** 
 Startup Rebuilding the AI Notetaker Around Rules of Privilege
 



 AI meetings that know what not to record. The technology is being built — by you.
 



  





**Location** 
 : Bengaluru, India (In Person only) Experience: Open to all levels — from exceptional new graduates to senior speech engineers. We hire for raw ability and slope, not years.
 



  





**What we're building** 




  





 What we're building An AI notetaker for the enterprise that captures every meeting like the tools you already know, then records
 *only what you've agreed to* 
 . A policy you write in plain words decides, in real time as people speak, what gets transcribed and what gets sealed. Privileged conversations, deal terms, customer data, and off\-hand admissions never reach the record. It can pull in counsel the moment a matter turns legal, surface context from past meetings, and keep a full audit trail of every decision, all running inside your own environment across Zoom, Meet, Teams, phone, and email.
 



  





 How it's different Every notetaker today (Otter, Granola, Fireflies, Copilot) makes the same bet: record the whole conversation, then produce a transcript. They only compete on
 *where the audio goes* 
 . None of them decide
 *what should be written down in the first place* 
 . We do. We're the only one that governs capture in the moment: privilege\-aware, running in your own tenant, with every decision logged.
 



  





 Why it matters For law firms, finance, healthcare, and government, anyone who handles privilege, deals, or regulated data, an ungoverned transcript is a liability. Every word is discoverable, leakable, and a compliance risk, and
 *one stray line can sink a case* 
 . These teams want AI notetaking, but they cannot accept indiscriminate capture. That is a large, urgent, underserved market, and we have a patent\-pending wedge into it.
 



  





 Who we're looking for You have lived this problem. You have worked on transcription or speech systems at a company like Google, Otter, or Granola, or you have built a comparable voice\-transcription product yourself, and you are
 *genuinely passionate* 
 about voice, meetings, and getting transcription right.
 



  





**The team is already building** 




  





 Our founding ML engineer was early hire \#10 at Otter.ai, where he spent eight years building the company's core AI from 0 to 1 — speaker diarization and recognition, streaming pipelines, and the LLM fine\-tuning and evaluation frameworks that took AI transcription from demo to daily habit for millions. He holds multiple issued U.S. patents in real\-time transcription, and he leads our engineering team today.
 



  





 The technology has its builder. What the company needs is additional engineering talent to realize its potential — the person who owns what gets built, who it's for, and how it gets sold.
 



  





**Track 1 — Speech \& ML** 




  





 The real\-time active\-inference engine: concurrently with transcription, over a rolling window of speech, classify each moment against natural\-language policy — detecting contemplated deals, named projects, contractual and litigation exposure — and choose an action before the words are committed.
 



 Streaming speech\-to\-text, decoding, VAD, and speaker diarization — learning directly from the engineer who built Otter's diarization from scratch.
 



 Per\-speaker consent enforced by voiceprint: speaker models and acoustic signatures that selectively transcribe only consenting participants, in real time.
 



 Model fine\-tuning and distillation for line\-rate policy classification; evaluation frameworks measuring false\-seal and false\-capture rates, diarization error, and latency budgets. Governance accuracy is the product.
 



  





**Track 2 — Real\-Time Audio \& Systems** 




  





 The real\-time audio spine: low\-latency streaming across Zoom, Meet, Teams, phone/SIP, and desktop audio — WebRTC, WebSockets, meeting\-platform bots and SDKs, jitter and latency engineering.
 



 A provably\-ephemeral memory architecture: audio lives in a volatile store only transiently; nothing reaches durable storage unless policy permits; when a moment is dropped, no copy is retained — provable absence, not a sealed record. If "we never wrote it down" can't be proven, the product doesn't work. This is the deepest systems problem here and the credibility anchor for regulated buyers.
 



 Encryption, key/secret lifecycle, retention and deletion guarantees, immutable audit logging, and deployment inside customer environments.
 



  





**Track 3 — Product \& Agent Engineering** 




  





 The natural\-language policy layer: an admin interface where compliance teams write governance rules in plain English, compiled into something the inference engine evaluates against live speech inside a tight latency budget, applied org\-wide.
 



 The action set the inference drives: transcribe and commit; drop; redact a single value; withhold as privileged; alert a reviewer; invite counsel from a directory; or surface a relevant document, regulation, or prior transcript via retrieval — sometimes through a rate\-limited in\-meeting agent that helps without taking over the room.
 



 Live meeting UX: real\-time transcript views, sealed\-moment indicators, and audit\-trail and compliance views for CFOs, GCs, and security teams. TypeScript/React front end, Python/Node services, real\-time state throughout.
 



  





**Who we're looking for** 




  





 Ideally, you have lived this problem: you've worked on transcription or speech systems at a company like Google, Otter, or Granola — or Deepgram, AssemblyAI, Fireflies, Rev, or a Whisper\-based product — or you've built a comparable voice product yourself, and you're genuinely passionate about voice, meetings, and getting transcription right. You want to own a product end to end, not be one engineer of fifty.
 



  





**But no prior industry experience is required.** 
 We would rather hire the best new graduate in India — and pay top of market for them — than an average engineer with five years of experience. Signals we care about:
 



  





**Exceptional CS fundamentals.** 
 Data structures, algorithms, systems. Top of your class at a top program (IIT, BITS, NIT, IIIT, or equivalent — or you outperformed that bar from anywhere).
 



 Evidence you build. A GitHub with real projects, open\-source contributions, something you shipped, research you published, or competitive results (ICPC, Codeforces, Kaggle). This is our strongest signal.
 



  





 Depth in at least one relevant area: ML/deep learning (PyTorch, Transformers), speech/audio, distributed systems, real\-time networking, or full\-stack product engineering.
 



 Python and one of C\+\+/Java/TypeScript. Clean, fast code; you profile before you guess.
 



 Curiosity about speech and language AI. You've trained a model, read the Whisper paper, or built something with an LLM because you couldn't help yourself.
 



 Founder energy. You move fast, own outcomes, and want to be an early engineer on something that matters.
 



  





**In\-person, in Bengaluru.** 
 This team works together in one room. That's how 0\-to\-1 gets built.
 



  





 Bonus points: on\-device/edge inference, model fine\-tuning, meeting\-platform bots and SDKs, LLM systems, privacy\- and security\-sensitive systems, or prior early/founding engineer experience.
 



  





**How we work — and what AI\-native means here** 




  





**AI\-native:** 
 you ship faster with AI than most teams do without it — because you can tell good output from plausible\-looking output, and you don't merge what you can't stand behind. You own the judgment; AI is your leverage. The bar is your taste, not the model's.
 



  





 This is governance software for privileged and regulated data, so speed and care aren't in tension — you're fast where it's cheap to be wrong and careful where it isn't. You ship real products, and you own every line.
 



  





**What you'll have shipped in your first year** 




  





 \~6 months: production code in a live pilot — policy\-driven drop/redact working end\-to\-end, with your components in the critical path.
 



 \~12 months: consent\-gated, multi\-channel capture in production and the ephemerality guarantee demonstrable under audit — and you've grown from apprentice to owner of a core subsystem.
 



 What you'll get
 



  





**Top\-of\-market pay.** 
 We benchmark against the best\-paying Bengaluru AI startups and pay at or above it. For a standout, we go beyond the band. Cash compensation leads; this is not an equity\-for\-salary trade.
 



 Potential for options as an early employee after 3 months, with standard vesting — meaningful upside as the company grows.
 



  





 An apprenticeship you cannot buy: daily, in\-person work with an Otter.ai founding\-era engineer — diarization, streaming ASR, LLM systems, and evals, learned at the source.
 



  





 Silicon Valley backing: PatentVC funding, patent\-pending IP drafted by the attorneys behind Trademarkia, and direct exposure to Sand Hill Road fundraising as it happens.
 



  





 Scope that compounds. The systems you build in year one are the company's core IP. No legacy code. A short path from apprentice to owner of a core subsystem.
 



 How to apply
 



  





 Apply through LinkedIn with your relevant experience — and include links to what you've built (GitHub, shipped products, papers, competition profiles). What you've built is our strongest signal.

title: Quality Control Executive
description:
Position: Quality Control (QC) Executive – Plate Washing (Night Shift)Facility

Department

Operations / Quality Assurance

Reporting To

Operations Manager / Facility Manager

Job Summary

The Quality Control (QC) Executive is responsible for ensuring that all cleaned plates, bowls, glasses, cutlery, serving utensils, crates, and other reusable food\-service items meet the company's quality, hygiene, and customer standards before dispatch. The role involves inspecting products at every stage of the washing, drying, sorting, packing, and dispatch process to ensure zero\-defect deliveries and maximum customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Quality Inspection

Inspect all washed plates, bowls, glasses, cutlery, trays, serving utensils, and containers before packing.

Ensure items are completely free from:

Food residue

Oil and grease

Water marks

Stains

Soap or detergent residue

Odor

Dust or contamination

Reject chipped, cracked, broken, bent, rusted, or damaged items.

Verify that all items meet company quality standards before approval.

2\. Dispatch Verification

Verify customer\-wise packing quantities before dispatch.

Ensure correct plate sizes, cutlery types, serving utensils, and accessories are packed according to the dispatch list.

Cross\-check dispatch against customer orders.

Prevent shortages, excess quantities, or wrong item dispatches.

3\. Process Monitoring

Monitor washing, rinsing, drying, sorting, and packing activities.

Ensure Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are followed at every stage.

Conduct random in\-process quality inspections during production.

Ensure rejected items are not mixed with approved inventory.

4\. Hygiene \& Food Safety

Maintain high hygiene standards in washing, drying, inspection, and packing areas.

Ensure employees follow personal hygiene requirements, including gloves, uniforms, masks, hairnets, and hand\-washing procedures.

Verify proper storage of cleaned utensils to prevent contamination.

Report any hygiene or sanitation violations immediately.

5\. Documentation \& Reporting

Maintain Daily QC Inspection Reports.

Record rejection quantities and rejection reasons.

Prepare Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) reports.

Maintain customer complaint records.

Report recurring quality issues to the Operations Manager.

6\. Continuous Improvement

Identify root causes of quality failures.

Recommend improvements in washing, drying, handling, and packing processes.

Assist in reducing customer complaints and product rejections.

Participate in quality improvement initiatives and internal audits.

Authority

The QC Executive has the authority to:

Stop dispatch of non\-conforming materials.

Reject damaged or improperly cleaned utensils.

Recommend rewash or rework of rejected items.

Escalate repeated quality issues to management.

Request corrective actions from Operations or Washing teams.

Required Skills

Excellent attention to detail.

Strong observation and inspection skills.

Basic knowledge of hygiene, sanitation, and food safety practices.

Ability to identify quality defects quickly.

Good communication and coordination skills.

Basic documentation and reporting skills.

Ability to work in a fast\-paced operational environment.

Problem\-solving and decision\-making ability.

Qualifications

Minimum: 12th Pass.

Graduate or Diploma in Hospitality, Food Technology, Quality, or Operations is preferred.

1–3 years of experience in Quality Control, Hospitality, Housekeeping, Laundry, Food Processing, Catering, Warehousing, or Manufacturing.

Freshers with strong learning ability and discipline may also be considered.

Preferred Qualities

Responsible and disciplined.

Honest and dependable.

Positive attitude.

High level of integrity.

Team player.

Punctual and reliable.

Ability to maintain consistent quality standards.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

100% inspection of all dispatch materials.

Zero dispatch of dirty or damaged items.

Reduction in customer quality complaints.

Reduction in rejected or returned materials.

100% compliance with SOPs and hygiene standards.

Dispatch quantity accuracy above 99\.5%.

Timely reporting of quality issues.

Reduction in rewash and rework percentage.

CAPA closure within defined timelines.

Working Conditions

Work in a plate washing and sanitation facility.

Standing and walking for extended periods.

Exposure to wet work areas and cleaning chemicals.

Rotational shifts, including weekends and holidays, as required.

Mandatory use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

Success in This Role

A successful QC Executive consistently ensures that every customer receives clean, hygienic, damage\-free, and accurately packed utensils while maintaining strict compliance with quality standards and contributing to continuous improvement in operational performance.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

title: HR and Marketing Executive
description:
We are seeking a versatile and dynamic **HR \& Social Media Executive** to manage our core employee relations while driving our digital presence.

In this dual\-function role, you will oversee end\-to\-end HR operations—from attendance and performance to employee escalations and basic accounting—while simultaneously building our brand story through creative social media management, content creation, and digital marketing.

If you are a people\-person who loves creating engaging digital content and thrives in a fast\-paced environment, this is an exciting opportunity to make a direct impact.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Human Resources \& Internal Operations**

* **Employee Management:** Oversee onboarding, offboarding, employee records, attendance, and leave tracking.
* **Performance \& Escalations:** Track KPI metrics, conduct performance reviews, handle staff grievances, and resolve internal team escalations promptly.
* **Basic Accounting \& Payroll:** Process monthly attendance for payroll, track staff allowances/reimbursements, and manage basic departmental accounting records.
* **Workplace Culture:** Foster a positive work culture across clinical and non\-clinical staff.

**Social Media, Design \& Marketing**

* **Social Media Management:** Plan, schedule, and publish regular content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google Business Profile.
* **Content \& Poster Design:** Create eye\-catching posters, flyers, reels, and digital graphics for promotions, health campaigns, and hospital updates (using Canva, Photoshop, or similar tools).
* **Digital Marketing:** Execute targeted ad campaigns (Meta Ads / Google Ads) to increase local community reach and pet parent engagement.
* **Online Engagement:** Respond to comments, direct messages, and online reviews professionally to maintain a positive brand reputation.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 3–5 years of experience handling HR operations, administrative tasks, or social media management (experience in healthcare, retail, or hospitality is a plus).
* **HR Tools \& Accounting:** Familiarity with basic HRMS tools, attendance tracking software, and MS Excel/Tally for basic accounting.
* **Creative Tools:** Proficiency in **Canva**, Adobe Creative Suite, or video editing apps (InShot, CapCut) for creating social media graphics and short\-form video reels.
* **Digital Marketing:** Practical knowledge of Meta Business Suite, basic ad targeting, and local SEO/Google Business profile optimization.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong conflict\-resolution abilities.

**Desired Attributes**

* **Multitasking Excellence:** Ability to balance structured administrative HR schedules with fast\-moving social media trends.
* **Empathy \& Professionalism:** Good judgment when handling employee sensitive issues or customer inquiries online.
* **Affinity for Pets:** Comfortable working in a pet\-friendly hospital environment.

title: Co-Founder and Medical Doctor (MBBS)
description:
About Mednevo

Mednevo is an early\-stage AI healthcare startup revolutionizing \*primary healthcare\* in India. We combine \*cutting\-edge AI technology\* with a genuine patient\-first approach to deliver accessible, personalized, and high\-quality care. Our platform integrates \*on\-demand virtual consultations, in\-home doctor visits, proactive wellness monitoring, and AI\-powered tools for interactive consultations, patient education, and personalized health insights.

We are particularly focused on making quality care — including pediatric care — more efficient, affordable, and scalable across urban and semi\-urban India. As a small, high\-impact team (2\-10 people), we move fast and solve real problems: reducing wait times, supporting clinical decisions with AI, improving outcomes for families and children, and building the future of intelligent healthcare delivery.

The Opportunity We are looking for a passionate Medical Doctor to join as a Co\-Founder. This is not a traditional clinical job — it is a founding leadership role where you will shape the clinical vision, build the product alongside AI engineers, and help scale a mission\-driven healthcare ecosystem. You will bring real\-world medical expertise (especially in pediatrics) to ensure our AI tools are clinically accurate, safe, empathetic, and truly useful for Indian families and doctors.

Key Responsibilities **⁠ ⁠**

**Clinical Leadership \& Product Vision: Co\-define the medical strategy and clinical pathways, with special focus on pediatric care, primary health, preventive wellness, and common childhood conditions.** ⁠ ⁠AI \+ Medicine Integration: Work closely with AI engineers to train, validate, and refine AI models for symptom assessment, triage, personalized advice, and decision support. Provide clinical oversight to ensure safety and accuracy. **⁠ ⁠**

**Patient Care Excellence: Lead or supervise virtual consultations and in\-home visits (initially hands\-on, later more strategic). Help design workflows that blend human empathy with AI efficiency.** ⁠ ⁠Product Development: Collaborate on building user\-friendly tools for doctors, patients, and parents — including pediatric growth tracking, vaccination reminders, developmental screening, and family health management. **⁠ ⁠**

**Regulatory \& Quality: Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, data privacy (HIPAA\-like standards), and medical ethics in India.** ⁠ ⁠Growth \& Ecosystem Building: Support fundraising, partnerships with hospitals/clinics, go\-to\-market strategy, and expansion of our AI\-hospital ecosystem. Represent Mednevo at medical conferences and among the doctor community.

**⁠ ⁠Team \& Culture: Help build a high\-trust, innovative team culture that attracts top medical and tech talent. What We’re Looking For** ⁠ ⁠Medical Qualification: MBBS from a recognized institution (mandatory). MD/DNB Pediatrics (pursuing or completed) is a strong advantage. **⁠ ⁠**

**Experience: 0\-2 years post\-MBBS (including internships or residency). Fresh graduates or final\-year MD candidates with strong academic records and genuine interest in technology are encouraged to apply.** ⁠ ⁠Passion for AI \& Innovation: Curiosity or experience in digital health, telemedicine, or AI applications in medicine. No prior tech experience required — we value clinical insight and willingness to learn. **⁠** 

**⁠Pediatric Interest: Strong preference for candidates with exposure to or deep interest in pediatrics — child health, neonatology, developmental pediatrics, or family medicine.** ⁠ ⁠Founder Mindset: Entrepreneurial spirit, ownership attitude, resilience, and excitement about building something from the ground up. Ability to wear multiple hats in a fast\-paced startup. **⁠ ⁠Skills: Excellent communication (especially with patients/parents), empathy, basic tech\-savviness, and comfort working in a remote/hybrid setup.** ⁠ ⁠Location: Open to candidates in Tamil Nadu, Kerala, or willing to relocate/base in Chennai/Thiruvananthapuram. What We Offer

**⁠ ⁠Significant Equity: As a Co\-Founder, you will receive meaningful ownership in the company — your impact will directly translate into long\-term rewards.** ⁠ ⁠Competitive Compensation: Stipend during the early phase, transitioning to market\-competitive pay as we grow and secure funding. **⁠ ⁠**

**Learning \& Impact: Direct mentorship from the Founder \& CEO. Opportunity to shape AI tools that can impact thousands of patients, especially children and families.** ⁠ ⁠Flexible Work: Remote\-first with support for in\-person clinical or team activities. **⁠ ⁠**

**Growth: Be part of a mission\-driven team at the intersection of AI, pediatrics, and healthcare innovation in one of India’s fastest\-growing sectors. title: HR Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and business\-oriented **HR Manager** to lead and manage the end\-to\-end Human Resources function. The ideal candidate will be responsible for talent acquisition, employee engagement, performance management, HR operations, policy implementation, payroll coordination, compliance, and organizational development. This role requires someone who can build strong relationships across departments, drive HR initiatives, and foster a high\-performance culture in a fast\-paced environment.

Key ResponsibilitiesTalent Acquisition

* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment across technical and non\-technical roles.

Employee Lifecycle Management

* Manage onboarding, induction, probation, confirmations, and exits.
* Conduct employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Handle employee grievances and conflict resolution.
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation.

Performance Management

* Drive the performance appraisal process.

* Support succession planning and career progression initiatives.

HR Operations

* Monitor employee data accuracy and reporting.
* Coordinate with Finance for payroll processing.

HR Policies \& Compliance

* Develop and implement HR policies aligned with business needs.
* Ensure compliance with labor laws and statutory requirements.
* Handle disciplinary actions and policy enforcement.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information.

Learning \& Development

* Identify training needs across departments.
* Coordinate technical, behavioral, and leadership training programs.
* Promote a culture of continuous learning.

Employee Engagement

* Organize employee engagement activities and recognition programs.
* Conduct employee satisfaction surveys.

* Prepare monthly HR dashboards and reports.

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.

* Experience with performance management frameworks.
* Payroll coordination and HR compliance knowledge.
* Strong reporting and analytical skills.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.

Soft Skills

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong leadership and decision\-making abilities.
* High level of ownership and accountability.
* Problem\-solving and conflict resolution skills.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

title: BMS Engineer
description:
**Job Title: BMS Engineer (Building Management System)**

**Job Summary:**  
The BMS Engineer is responsible for the installation, testing, commissioning, programming, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Building Management Systems (BMS) and integrated ELV systems. The engineer ensures all systems operate efficiently according to project specifications and client requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, test, and commission BMS systems.
* Read and interpret electrical drawings, control schematics, and BMS layouts.
* Program and configure BMS controllers, HMI, and SCADA systems.
* Integrate HVAC, Fire Alarm, Chiller, AHU, FCU, VFD, Lighting, DG, and Energy Monitoring systems.
* Perform I/O testing, point\-to\-point checking, and functional testing.
* Troubleshoot BMS hardware, software, and communication network issues.
* Prepare commissioning reports, as\-built drawings, and technical documentation.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, and MEP contractors during project execution.
* Attend site meetings and provide technical support.
* Ensure compliance with safety standards and project quality requirements.
* Conduct preventive and corrective maintenance of BMS systems.

**Required Skills**

* Good knowledge of HVAC controls and automation.
* Experience with PLC, DDC Controllers, HMI, and SCADA.
* Knowledge of communication protocols:
* BACnet
* Modbus RTU/TCP
* KNX
* LonWorks
* OPC
* Understanding of electrical control panels and instrumentation.
* Ability to read AutoCAD drawings and electrical schematics.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and teamwork abilities.

**Qualifications**

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or Automation Engineering.
* 2–5 years of experience in BMS installation, commissioning, or maintenance (or fresher with relevant training).

**Preferred Experience**

Experience with one or more BMS platforms such as:

* Siemens Desigo
* Honeywell EBI
* Schneider EcoStruxure
* Johnson Controls Metasys
* Delta Controls
* Distech Controls
* ABB
* Tridium Niagara

**Key Responsibilities on Site**

* Site survey and planning
* Cable inspection and termination
* Panel testing
* Controller programming
* Sensor calibration
* Functional testing
* Client demonstration
* Final commissioning
* AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract) support

About DHL Blue Dart Express India:


Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


Position Overview:


The Ops Staff is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


Job Purpose:


To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


Key Roles \& Responsibilities:


Shipment Processing \& Operations

* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.


Data Entry \& Operational Documentation

* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.


Operational Support

* Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.


Safety, Security \& Compliance

* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.


Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.


Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement

* Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.


Qualifications \& Experience:


Education:

* Minimum 10th Standard Pass.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.


Experience:

* Fresher or up to 2 years of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.


Eligibility Requirements:

* Minimum age 18 years.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.


Skills \& Capabilities:


Technical Skills:

* Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage
* Basic Computer Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding


Key Competencies:

* Operational Discipline
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Integrity \& Accountability
* Time Management
* Learning Agility
* Safety Consciousness
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Grooming \& Appearance


Key Performance Indicators:


KRAs KPIs


Operational Productivity Shipments Processed • Sorting \& Processing Productivity • SLA Adherence


Quality \& Accuracy Scanning Accuracy • Zero Mis\-sort • Shipment Handling Accuracy


Safety \& Compliance SOP Compliance • Safety Compliance • Zero Safety Violations


Operational Discipline Attendance • Punctuality • Uniform \& Grooming Standards • Workplace Discipline


Teamwork \& Operational Support Team Collaboration • Process Adherence • Support During Peak Operations \& Continuous Learning


Why join DHL Blue Dart?


When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* Competitive pay and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, global exposure, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* Best\-in\-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.

Job description:

**Job Description:**  
**Area Placement Manager**

**Company Overview**

ICA Edu Skills Pvt. Ltd. is one of India's premier vocational training and skill development institutes, specialized in accounts, finance, taxation, and digital skills. We are dedicated to bridging the gap between education and employment by delivering job\-guaranteed courses and securing meaningful career starts for our students.

* **Position Title:** Area Placement Manager / Placement Manager
* **Location:** Karol Bagh / Connaught Place, New Delhi (Covering Delhi NCR \& North India)
* **Employment Type:** Full\-time
* **Experience Required:** 3 to 6 years in vocational, EdTech, or college placement
* **Reports To:** Regional Placement Head / National Placement Head
* **Generate job vacancies** by pitching ICA’s certified accounting, GST, and finance talent to new employers daily.
* **Sign MoUs and partnership letters** with corporates, MNCs, CA firms, and retail banks to establish formal hiring pipelines.
* **Map Delhi's industrial hubs** (e.g., Okhla, Kirti Nagar, Noida, Gurugram) to consistently discover fresh employment pockets.

**2\. Operations \& Interview Management**

* **Organize regular placement drives**, on\-campus recruitment events, and mega job fairs across Delhi NCR centers.
* **Match and screen candidate profiles** precisely against employer requirements prior to resume sharing.
* **Coordinate interview loops** seamlessly, compiling feedback from HRs to share with the internal training faculties.

**3\. Student Readiness \& Retention Tracking**

* **Monitor candidate preparation** by tracking attendance in Group Discussions and Personal Interview (GDPI) workshops.
* **Track 3\-month employment retention** by conducting post\-placement check\-ins with both corporate clients and placed alumni.

**4\. Team Leadership \& Strategy**

* **Manage a localized team** of placement executives, setting clear monthly sourcing and placement goals.
* **Travel across North India** (including Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, and UP) to support franchise networks with local hiring drives.
* **Maintain rigorous MIS reports**, documenting all pipelines, corporate visits, and placement metrics for management reviews

* **Education:** Graduate or Post\-Graduate degree (MBA in HR or Marketing is highly preferred).
* **Network:** Pre\-existing network of HR contacts in BFSI, IT, retail, or manufacturing sectors across Delhi NCR.
* **Communication:** Exceptional English and Hindi verbal communication skills to influence corporate decision\-makers.

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)

* Route Familiarity

* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.

* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.

title: Software Development Engineer - I
description:
**About GoKwik**
 GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, powering merchants across checkout optimisation, RTO reduction, payments, retention, and post\-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik enables 15,000\+ merchants globally, processes \~$2 billion in GMV, and is rapidly scaling across India, the UK, Europe, and the US. Backed by RTP Global, Z47, Peak XV, and Think Investments, GoKwik has raised $68 million in funding, including a $13 million growth round in June 2025, and is building AI\-powered infrastructure to shape the future of eCommerce.
   

  

 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 As a Software Development Engineer \- I, you'll build the backend systems that power millions of eCommerce transactions and experiences. From checkout and payments to RTO reduction and merchant\-facing products, you'll write production\-grade code, ship customer\-facing features, and work alongside experienced engineers to build scalable, reliable systems. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership early while developing deep technical expertise in distributed systems and modern backend engineering.
   

  

 What You'll Own
   

  

* Build, maintain, and optimize backend services using Node.js and NestJS, with exposure to Go as part of the engineering stack.
* Develop scalable APIs and backend systems using PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
* Contribute to event\-driven architectures using Kafka and collaborate with senior engineers on distributed systems.
* Ship end\-to\-end features, including frontend contributions using React and Svelte when required.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code while participating in peer code reviews.
* Debug production issues, identify root causes, and implement long\-term solutions.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and deployments on AWS.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to deliver high\-quality product experiences.


 Who You Are
   

  

* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and problem\-solving fundamentals.
* Hands\-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and NestJS.
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and cloud platforms such as AWS.
* Exposure to Go, Redis, or Kafka is an advantage.
* Comfortable contributing across the stack, including frontend technologies like React or Svelte.
* Curious, proactive, and eager to learn while taking ownership of engineering challenges.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.


 Why GoKwik
   

  

 At GoKwik, you'll build products that power thousands of merchants and millions of shoppers while working with a high\-calibre engineering team. You'll gain exposure to modern technologies, solve complex scaling challenges, and take ownership of meaningful projects from day one. If you're excited about building high\-impact systems in a fast\-moving environment, GoKwik offers the platform to accelerate your engineering career.

description:

 to lead performance appraisal systems and operations. The candidate will be responsible for developing measurable performance standards, monitoring employee productivity, managing the employee lifecycle, strengthening HR policies, and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day operations.

**Policy and Compliance Management** 



* Develop, review, and implement policies, standard operating procedures, and employee guidelines.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian labour laws and statutory requirements.

* Coordinate with legal consultants, auditors, government authorities, and external service providers when required.

* **MBA in Human Resource Management is mandatory.**

title: Human Resource Manager
description:
**Company Description** 




 Season Two, the senior care brand of SP Life Care, is dedicated to transforming the lives of older adults in India through comprehensive lifestyle, health, and social support. Recognizing that existing care ecosystems have not kept pace with rising life expectancy, Season Two is building personalized care solutions powered by pioneering digital interventions. The organization operates senior living homes and home care services, with a prototype facility in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala that offers independent and assisted living, an Ayurveda center, family health center, yoga, physiotherapy, and dining facilities. With a committed investment of over US $50 million, Season Two is expanding services to Bangalore and Kochi, and partnering with technology and healthcare startups to build specialized senior care offerings.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Human Resource Manager will be responsible for developing and executing HR strategies that support the organizational goals of Season Two Senior Living. This role involves overseeing recruitment, training, employee engagement, performance management, HR compliance, and the creation of a positive and service\-oriented workplace culture that reflects the company’s values of empathy, respect, and excellence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 1\. Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding
 


* Develop and implement staffing strategies to attract, hire, and retain high quality talent across all levels, especially care staff, hospitality professionals, and administrators.
* Collaborate with department heads to forecast hiring needs.
* Oversee end\-to\-end recruitment processes including job postings, interviews, background checks, and offer negotiations.
* Lead employee onboarding and orientation programs to ensure smooth integration and alignment with company culture.



 2\. Employee Relations \& Engagement
 


* Foster a supportive and inclusive work environment that reflects the compassionate ethos of senior care.
* Address employee grievances promptly and in accordance with company policy.
* Organize employee engagement initiatives, wellness programs, and teambuilding activities.
* Conduct regular feedback sessions and stay interviews to ensure staff satisfaction and retention.



 3\. Training \& Development
 


* Identify training needs and coordinate professional development programs for staff.
* Collaborate with healthcare and hospitality experts to design specialized training for caregiving, safety, and customer service.
* Promote a continuous learning culture across the organization.

title: Senior HR Manager (India Tech Center)
