title: Data Analysis
description:
**Job Description:**


We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, training \& development, employment cycle changes, talent management, and facilities management services.


Responsibilities:

* Enhances the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating employee relations and human resources policies, programs, and practices.
* Maintains the work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions.
* Supports organization staff by establishing and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; and recommending changes.
* Prepares employees for assignments by establishing and conducting orientation and training programs.
* Manages a pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.
* Ensures planning, monitoring, and appraisal of employee work results by training managers to coach and discipline employees; scheduling management conferences with employees; hearing and resolving employee grievances; and counselling employees and supervisors.
* Implements employee benefits programs and informs employees of benefits by studying and assessing benefit needs and trends; recommending benefit programs to management; directing the processing of benefit claims; obtaining and evaluating benefit contract bids; awarding benefit contracts; and designing and conducting educational programs on benefit programs.
* Ensures legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state requirements, conducting investigations, maintaining records, and representing the organization at hearings.

title: People Support Services Partner
description:
Location: Noida, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.


Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.**Primary Purpose of Role**


The People Services Partner role is aligned to the Thales HR organization and will provide HR services to various regions. The role will provide first level support to employees, HR, managers and vendors with Human Resources needs, including but not limited to company policy, procedures, learning, HR systems, employee onboarding etc. ensuring all SLA’s are met.  

  

**Key Responsibilities \& Accountabilities**

**Case Management:**

* Respond to a wide variety of employee queries.
* Thoroughly document inquiries via the case management tool to ensure required information is recorded accurately in accordance with policies and practices.
* Track and follow up on employee\-related matters.
* Ensure SLA’s are followed and met.

**Onboarding:**

* Complete and track new hire activities from offer letter creation through the end of their onboarding.
* Initiate any business\-specific tasks required during the onboarding process.
* Coordinate immigration and relocation processes and interact with immigration consultants and vendors to establish correct documentation, procedures, and requirements for external hires.
* Communicate with the new hire regarding next steps, outstanding actions, and any questions they may have.
* Support the Talent Acquisition Team with any requisition corrections or troubleshoot any difficulties.
* Track and monitor probation completion.

**HRIS:**

* Ensure integrity and quality of data in the HRIS databases as well as in the Case Management System.
* Support HRIS data records and workflow pertaining to employees and ensure entries are timely, accurate and consistent in relation to employee data.
* Support generation of standard HRIS reports as requested.
* Participate with testing in instances for new HRIS rollouts.

**Employee Data Management:**

* Ensure integrity and quality of data in the HRIS databases as well as in the Case Management System.
* Support HRIS data records and workflow pertaining to employees and ensure entries are timely, accurate and consistent in relation to cost center transfers, collective agreements, etc.
* Review employee transactions and generate appropriate documents and letters as needed.
* Escalate any Tier 2 HRIS issues to the relevant team.

**Training:**

* Update available courses and training records in the Learning Management System (LMS).
* Assist employees and managers in the use of the LMS.
* Schedule requested trainings.
* Assist in preparing training materials as needed for internally hosted events.
* Manage procurement requisitions and invoicing related to courses and training materials.

**Talent and Performance**

* Generate reports as required
* Support transactions in Workday to support processes
* Support manager and employees on process queries

**Offboarding**

* Coordinate and trigger voluntary post\-termination activities such as post\-termination letters and departure checklists
* Complete all post termination actions e.g enrolling in alumni networks, removal from any assigned future events
* Consolidate exit insights results

**Other:**

* Initiate employee notifications as required.
* Prepare various employee letters in a timely manner outside of the HRIS workflow (letter of employment/employment verification, invitation letters, salary and merit letters etc.).
* Participate in audits as needed (probation, data checks).
* Contribute to the development of HR process documents and employee reference materials.
* Maintain knowledge of company and departmental policies and procedures.
* Support Thales’ HR department with special projects, mass communications, and other duties as needed and assigned.

**Experience and Skills:**

* Either 2\-years of experience in of experience working in HR or an administrative support role or a University Degree or Diploma in Human Resources or a related field
* Proficient in English (both written and oral).
* Ability to work well and collaborate in a team environment.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Ability to handle situations tactfully when dealing with customers.
* Ability to prioritize duties during periods of high volume and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong time management skills (meeting SLAs).
* Discretion to deal with personal and confidential information with sensitivity and tact.
* Adaptable to changing business practices.
* Proficient with Microsoft Outlook, Excel and Word.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Solid critical thinking skills.

**Highly Desirable:**

* Prior experience with ServiceNow or another HR case management tool.
* Prior experience with Workday or similar HRIS systems.
* Knowledge of HR practices either through post\-secondary education, an HR professional designation, and/or work experience in HR.
* Experience in a customer service or shared services environment.

**Education and Qualifications:**
---------------------------------

* A Graduate Degree.


At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Sr Specialist - Vendor Relationship
description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues \- experts in their fields \- who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients \- who are at the heart of everything we do.  



  

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.  



  

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.  



  

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.  



  

  

**Job Description:**

**The Opportunity**

Global Procurement \& Payment (GPP) function at Sun Life is establishing a Global Vendor Relationship team as a result of continuously forming strategic relationship with key vendors and monitoring the risks related to vendors. This is to ensure compliance to regulatory requirements on vendor management and strengthen Sun Life’s strategic partnerships.


This role is to manage medium risk and high spend categories across Sun Life to cover key vendors in categories, such as Medical Operations, Business Operations, HR, etc.


This role reports to Sr Manager, Global Procurement \& Payment.


**What you will do:**

* **Relationship Management:** Act as a key liaison between internal teams and external vendors to foster collaborative partnerships. Understand business needs and develop and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders (legal, risk, finance, etc.) Collaborate with GPP Category \& Sourcing.
* **Data collection, dashboarding and reporting** : Collect various data elements but not limited to service overviews, Spend, Contract renewal and expiry, Contractual obligation requirements, surveys, external market data events, risk for holistic view on Vendor performance.
* **Financial \& Cost Management:** Monitor invoice alignment to contract, ensure service credits are received/applied.
* **Contract Lifecycle Management:** Managing contract renewals including Master, and terminations, ensuring compliance with Sun Life Standards .
* **Risk \& Compliance:** Identify and mitigate operational risks associated with third\-party providers, ensuring compliance with policies.
* **Process Improvement:** Identify opportunities to optimize vendor services, enhance efficiency, and reduce costs by leveraging including but not limited to data, stakeholder feedback and external sources.

**What you will need to succeed:**

* Relevant Industry Experience: A background in IT Software, IT infrastructure, Finance/Insurance Operations is preferred.
* Supplier \& Stakeholder Relationship Management: Exceptional interpersonal skills to build and maintain trust\-based relationships with both our vendors and internal stakeholders, fostering collaboration, alignment, and continuous improvement.
* Contract Management Expertise: Demonstrable post\-deal contract management experience, including ensuring adherence to contract terms and managing a portfolio of contracts renewal.
* Risk \& Compliance Management: Experience identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks while ensuring compliance with legal, risk, information security and other standards.
* Analytical and Problem\-Solving Skills: A proven ability to interpret data, identify trends, and resolve issues to improve performance and enhance supplier efficiency.
* Commercial Acumen: Proven ability to deliver cost efficiency and added value from contract management, with a sound understanding of financial and business principles.
* **Communication:** Solid communication skills (Verbal \& written) and experience working with global counterparts in North America and Asia.
* Mindset of Continuous Improvement.

**Job Qualifications:**

* **6 years** \+ relevant experience in vendor management and/or procurement , supplier contracting, risk assessment, information security review process is required.
* Project Management skills
* Clear, concise, and influential verbal and written communication skills are required
* Strong problem solving skills required
* University or college degree in Business Management, Economics, Finance, IT, or a related field; MBA is a plus.

**Job Category:**

Procurement

title: HR Administrator
description:
Description:
**About York Solutions**


With over 25 years of experience, we are a technology consulting firm that uses a non\-transactional, value\-based approach to provide clients with custom technology and workforce solutions to achieve business, technology, and operational goals. Using a strategic partnership approach with our clients, York Solutions focuses on fostering a long\-term, trust\-based relationship.

**Position Overview**


The HR Administrator will support the day\-to\-day administration of HR programs and employee processes for York Solutions India Private Limited. This position maintains accurate employee records, coordinates onboarding and offboarding, prepares employment and exit documentation, and helps ensure HR activities are completed accurately, confidentially, and on time.


This role serves as the designated local compliance representative and point of contact for labor law and regulatory coordination, working closely with the HR, payroll and compliance teams to ensure timely administration of statutory requirements and HR processes.


The ideal candidate is organized, detail\-oriented, responsive, and comfortable supporting employees throughout the employment lifecycle with the guidance of HR leadership. This person will need to be located in the **Bangalore** **area**.

**Key Responsibilities**


Employee Onboarding

* Assist with onboarding process for new Employees.
* Ensure new employees complete their profiles and required employment documentation, tax information, IDs and statutory documents in GreytHR and any other company systems.
* Track outstanding onboarding requirements and follow up with employees and internal teams.


HR Documentation and Employee Records

* Prepare standard employment documents, including: Probation confirmation letters, Probation extension letters, Employment verification letters, Relieving letters, Experience letters, Resignation acknowledgments.
* Maintain trackers for probation periods, contract expiration dates, employee changes, leave, benefits eligibility, and required documentation.
* Assist with employees updating information in GreytHR and other authorized HR systems and processes.
* Protect confidential employee and company information.


Leave and Attendance Administration

* Assist employees and managers with GreytHR leave and attendance processes.
* Monitor leave requests, attendance records, holidays, and employee absences.
* Maintain accurate leave documentation and escalate extended or potentially protected absences to HR leadership.
* Support compliance with company leave policies and applicable statutory requirements.


Benefits Administration

* Maintain benefits eligibility records and notify employees of enrollment opportunities.
* Coordinate employee enrollments, dependent additions, and other eligible changes with the benefits provider.
* Assist employees with general benefits questions while directing coverage or claim decisions to the appropriate provider.
* Maintain confidential benefits records and enrollment documentation.
* Support employee communications regarding benefits programs and enrollment deadlines.


Employee Changes and Offboarding

* Assist with approved employee changes, including transfers, promotions, compensation changes, manager changes, and employment\-category changes.
* Coordinate employee resignations and separations.
* Prepare required exit documentation and support final payroll processing.
* Coordinate the return of company property with IT and other internal departments.
* Assist with employment verification requests in accordance with company policy.


HR Compliance and Reporting

* Maintain HR records, trackers, and reports needed to support statutory and company requirements.
* Assist Nexdigm / York with maintaining required registers, notices, acknowledgments, and employee documentation.
* Support compliance activities related to workplace conduct, and Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) requirements.
* Immediately forward government notices, legal correspondence, inspections, employee complaints, or compliance concerns to HR leadership and the appropriate advisor.
* Assist with internal and external HR audits by organizing requested records.
* Assist HR Leader with India Authorized Representative and local contact for statutory labor compliance purposes.
* Support the preparation and maintenance of statutory compliance registers, employee records, and documentation required under applicable labor laws and regulations.
* Maintain local contact information with government authorities and regulatory bodies as required.
* Receive communications, notices, correspondence, and inquiries from labor and regulatory authorities and promptly forward them to the designated payroll, HR, compliance leaders for review and action.
* Assist in communication and coordination between authorities and the payroll, HR and compliance team when required.
* Assist with payroll and compliance providers regarding statutory filings, registrations, labor law requirements, and compliance\-related documentation.
* Assist with compliance calendars and track statutory deadlines and reporting requirements.
* Assist with compliance audits and documentation requests.
* Assist and perform any other task or responsibilities given.


Requirements:
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field preferred.
* Two or more years of HR administration or HR operations experience in India preferred.
* Experience with onboarding, employee records, payroll coordination, leave administration, and offboarding.
* Familiarity with Indian employment practices and statutory HR documentation.
* Experience using an HRIS; GreytHR experience is preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.


**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent organization and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines and flexibility to handle changes.
* Sound and discreet judgment when handling confidential information.
* Professional and responsive employee service.
* Ability to follow established processes and escalate issues appropriately.
* Strong recordkeeping and reporting skills.
* Ability to work effectively with employees, managers, vendors, and international HR teams.
* Willingness to learn and adapt as HR processes and statutory requirements change.


To learn more about our company, please visit: www.yorksolutions.net

**York Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer**: Applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of their Race, Color, Creed, Religion, Sex, Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity, National Origin, Age, Genetic Information, Disability, Marital Status, Familial Status, Protected Veteran Status, or any other legally protected group status. We welcome people of all abilities and want to ensure that our hiring and interview process meets the needs of all applicants. If you require reasonable accommodation to make your application or interview experience a great one, please just let us know.

title: Group Human Resources Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced and dependable Human Resources Manager to oversee the complete employee lifecycle, with a strong focus on recruitment, employee performance, disciplinary matters, and terminations.

The successful candidate will be responsible for hiring qualified employees, supporting management with staffing decisions, handling sensitive workplace matters professionally, and ensuring all HR actions comply with applicable employment laws and company policies.

Key Responsibilities:

* Manage the complete recruitment process, including creating job postings, screening applications, conducting interviews, checking references, and preparing employment offers.
* Work with management to identify staffing requirements and hire suitable candidates for office, sales, warehouse, and operational positions.
* Coordinate employee onboarding, orientation, employment documentation, and probationary\-period reviews.
* Maintain accurate and confidential employee records, contracts, attendance information, warnings, and performance documentation.
* Develop and maintain workplace policies, employee handbooks, job descriptions, and HR procedures.
* Monitor employee attendance, conduct, productivity, and workplace performance.
* Support managers in addressing performance concerns, employee complaints, workplace conflicts, and disciplinary matters.
* Prepare written warnings, performance improvement plans, and other disciplinary documentation.
* Manage employee terminations professionally, including documentation, termination meetings, final\-pay coordination, and return of company property.
* Ensure hiring, discipline, layoffs, and terminations comply with applicable employment standards, human rights requirements, and company policies.
* Conduct workplace investigations and document findings when necessary.
* Assist with compensation reviews, vacation tracking, benefits administration, payroll information, and employee leave requests.
* Promote a respectful, productive, and professional workplace culture.

Qualifications:

* Diploma or degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Previous experience in an HR Manager, HR Generalist, or similar position.
* Strong experience with recruitment, employee relations, performance management, discipline, and termination procedures.
* Good understanding of applicable employment laws and workplace regulations.
* Excellent communication, interviewing, conflict\-resolution, and decision\-making skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Comfortable making difficult and fair employment decisions when required.

The ideal candidate will be confident, organized, fair, and capable of managing sensitive employee matters independently while protecting both the company and its employees.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

title: Junior HR Associate
description:
**About Us:**


**Fresh Prints** is a New York\-based custom apparel startup. We work with talented student entrepreneurs and provide the working capital, training, and support they need to build businesses at their schools.



At most companies, recruiting is about filling open roles. At Fresh Prints, recruiting is about building the teams that determine where the company goes next. Every hire shapes how fast we grow, how well our teams perform, and what we're capable of building. That's why we don't see Talent Acquisition as a support function. We see it as a strategic capability that directly influences the business.



This role goes far beyond posting jobs and coordinating interviews. We're looking for someone who enjoys building pipelines before they're needed, questioning existing processes, and finding smarter ways to help great people discover Fresh Prints.


**Role Overview**



As a Jr. HR Associate at Fresh Prints, you will support talent acquisition efforts across multiple roles. You'll work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates to help deliver a seamless hiring experience from sourcing through hiring. This role is ideal for someone who is detail\-oriented, proactive, highly organized, and eager to build a career in recruitment and people operations.


**Key Responsibilities**



As a member of our Recruitment team, you're going to have a wide\-ranging group of responsibilities and goals. On a day\-to\-day basis, this means:


* Lead prospecting and headhunting efforts. Not just finding the right candidates, but nurturing relationships early and building long\-term pipelines.
* Source candidates from diverse channels and screen resumes and applications with a strong quality bar.
* Take hands\-on ownership of role coordination that goes beyond scheduling (much of which is automated) to stay closely involved in progress, blockers, and outcomes for each role.
* Conduct interviews and coordinate multiple rounds of assessments.
* Partner closely with hiring managers to align on role expectations, feedback, and hiring timelines.
* Communicate clearly with management and team members to provide regular status updates.
* Develop search strategies to identify and attract top talent.
* Take ownership of recruitment\-related projects and additional responsibilities as needed.


**Requirements**


* Preferably 1\.5\+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruitment
* Fresh graduates of Human Resources or Psychology are highly encouraged to apply
* Strong attention to detail with relentless follow\-up
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
* Experience in a start\-up environment is a huge plus
* Strong internship experience in HR or Recruitment is highly preferred.
* Experience in a startup environment or in\-house recruitment is a plus.
* Experience working in a remote environment is preferred.


**Compensation \& Benefits**


* **Monthly Salary:** Between $400 to $550, with a night allowance of $40

**Location \& Timings**


* **Full\-time remote** role starting as soon as the right candidate is found.
* **Working Hours:** 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST, Monday to Friday

title: S4C - Training coordinator
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**


As a **Training Coordinator**, you will help plan, organise, and deliver training activities as part of our SAP S/4HANA transformation programme. You'll work closely with subject matter experts (SMEs), trainers, and business teams to ensure employees have the knowledge and support they need before and after system go\-live.


This is a hands\-on role ideal for someone who enjoys coordinating activities, creating training content, working with different stakeholders, and keeping projects on track.

**About Role**

**Training Coordination**

* Help plan and schedule training activities.
* Organise training sessions across multiple teams and locations.
* Manage training calendars, meeting invites, and logistics.
* Coordinate with trainers, SMEs, and stakeholders to ensure training runs smoothly.

**Training Content \& Materials**

* Assist in creating and updating training materials, presentations, user guides, and quick reference guides.
* Work with business experts to turn complex processes into easy\-to\-understand training content.
* Ensure training materials are clear, consistent, and up to date.
* Gather feedback from training participants and help improve future sessions.
* Support refresher and follow\-up training after go\-live.

**Tracking \& Reporting**

* Monitor training attendance and completion rates.
* Maintain training trackers and dashboards.
* Provide regular updates on training progress.
* Identify and raise potential issues early, such as low attendance or training gaps.
* Support user readiness activities with training data and insights.

**Stakeholder Support**

* Work closely with the Organizational Change Management (OCM) team to understand training needs.
* Communicate training schedules, updates, and expectations to different audiences.
* Help ensure employees are ready and confident to use new SAP processes and systems.
**IMPORTANT: WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**

*This is not a leadership or management position. We are not looking for an OCM Lead, Manager, or someone whose experience is primarily in strategy, governance, or team management. This role is focused on execution and coordination. We’re looking for someone who can manage training schedules, support content creation, ensure sessions run smoothly, and keep the programme on track.*

***NOTE:*** *Supporting EU/US timezones: flexibility around work hours is to be expected*

**About you**

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* Experience supporting or coordinating training activities on an SAP S/4HANA project.
* Experience using **SAP Enable Now** to create or maintain training materials.
* Strong organisational and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable working with stakeholders across different teams and levels.
* Proactive, detail\-oriented, and able to work independently.
**Nice to Have**

* Experience supporting SAP transformation projects in Healthcare, MedTech, or Pharmaceutical organisations.
* Knowledge of role\-based training or train\-the\-trainer approaches.
* Exposure to Finance, Supply Chain, HR, or other business process transformation programmes.
* Experience supporting large\-scale system implementations.

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


People Analytics \& Insights (PAI) team is part of Human Resource Department. This team is equipped to assist our clients with quick insights, dashboards, reporting resources and guides that will help deliver actionable insights and transform how the firm leverages human capital data which in turn helps in data driven decision making.


Reporting Solutions Analyst role is primarily focused on reporting and data management. This role is part of Reporting Solutions which is an integral part of People Analytics \& Insights team. Role will require specialty area knowledge in monitoring, assessing, analyzing and/or evaluating processes and data. Interpreting data and making recommendations. Identifying inconsistencies in data or results, defining business issues and formulate recommendations on policies, procedures or practices. Role demands to have good understanding of how the team interacts with others in accomplishing the objectives of the area.


Responsibilities:


* This function covers incumbents responsible for various data activities, which includes data analysis, maintenance, data quality, and database management.
* Develop, Maintain, and Deliver recurring and ad\-hoc reports, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timelines.
* Following Internal Processes like following SOPs for report preparation, updating internal trackers, following maker checker process etc.
* Partnering internally within PAI team members to understand reporting needs and provide effective data solutions.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
* Handling sensitive data with the highest level of care, ensuring strict adherence to processes, data privacy standards, and organizational guidelines when sharing information with clients and stakeholders.
* Performing Dashboard Validations in Tableau and collaborating with PAI Data Science team to validate and test HR dashboards for accuracy, usability and business relevance.
* Focusing on continuous improvement and proactively identifying opportunities to streamline reporting processes, enhance data visualization and improve the overall reporting experience
* Creating and Maintaining clear documentation for reporting processes, methodologies, and data definitions to ensure consistency and transparency.
* Equipping yourself with a thorough understanding of existing tableau dashboards/ products to effectively interpret, validate and enhance reporting solutions.

  

Qualifications:


* Min 3 – 5 years of experience in handling data in a corporate environment, HR Data \& Reporting experience is a plus.
* Intermediate expertise in Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel (formulas, pivot, tables, data analysis, conditional formatting etc.) \& PowerPoint (presentation building).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey data insights clearly.
* Working knowledge of Business Intelligence (BI) tools ( e.g. – Tableau) or SharePoint site is an added advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and comfort working with large datasets and multiple data sources.
* A proactive, “go\-to” attitude with the ability to take initiative and work independently.

title: Instructional Designer (Learning & Development)
description:
**Description**
---------------


**About the Role**


As a member of SIDE's Global Player Support organization, the Instructional Designer is responsible for designing, developing, and continuously improving learning solutions that support onboarding, operational readiness, and long\-term service excellence across our global Player Support programs.


Working closely with Learning \& Development, Operations, Quality, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and client stakeholders, you will transform operational knowledge into engaging, learner\-focused experiences that accelerate knowledge acquisition, improve performance, and ensure teams are prepared to deliver exceptional player support.


Every role follows a structured onboarding and development pathway designed to build confidence, strengthen operational knowledge, and prepare individuals for success in a live support environment.  

  



**What You'll Be Doing**


* Design, develop, and maintain engaging learning materials for onboarding, upskilling, and continuous learning programs.
* Create instructor\-led, virtual instructor\-led, self\-paced, and blended learning content using instructional design best practices.
* Translate complex operational processes, workflows, and product knowledge into clear, learner\-friendly training materials.
* Develop structured learning paths, certification programs, knowledge checks, assessments, and practical learning activities.
* Partner with Operations, Training, Quality, and Subject Matter Experts to gather requirements and ensure learning content reflects current operational processes.
* Support knowledge transfer activities during new client implementations, program transitions, and process changes.
* Continuously review and update learning content based on operational feedback, quality insights, learner performance, and business requirements.
* Maintain version control and governance across learning documentation, job aids, facilitator guides, participant materials, and knowledge repositories.
* Evaluate learning effectiveness through learner feedback, assessment results, and operational performance metrics to recommend improvements.
* Ensure learning content aligns with adult learning principles and supports different learning styles.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance learner engagement, knowledge retention, and operational readiness.
**Requirements**
----------------


**What You'll Bring**


* **2–3 years of experience in an Instructional Designer, Learning Content Developer, or similar Learning \& Development role**.
* **Experience designing learning solutions within Customer Support, Player Support, Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Gaming**, or similar operational environments is preferred.
* Strong understanding of instructional design methodologies and adult learning principles.
* **Relevant certifications in Instructional Design, eLearning development, or adult learning methodologies** are an advantage.
* Excellent written communication, content writing, and information structuring skills.
* Ability to simplify complex operational concepts into engaging and easy\-to\-understand learning experiences.
* Experience developing instructor\-led, e\-learning, self\-paced, and blended learning programs.
* Experience creating assessments, quizzes, facilitator guides, learner guides, job aids, and knowledge documentation.
* Strong project management and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders across Operations, Training, Quality, and Program teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, SharePoint, Confluence, and Learning Management Systems (LMS).
* **Experience using instructional authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond**, or similar platforms is desirable.
* Basic graphic design, multimedia, or video editing skills are an advantage.

**Keys to Success**


* Design engaging learning experiences that improve onboarding quality, operational readiness, and learner confidence.
* Deliver high\-quality learning content that remains accurate, current, and aligned with evolving operational requirements.
* Translate operational expertise into scalable learning solutions that improve knowledge retention and employee performance.
* Build trusted partnerships with Learning, Operations, Quality, and Program stakeholders to ensure learning remains relevant and effective.
* Continuously evaluate and enhance learning materials using learner feedback, quality insights, and operational performance data.
* Promote a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and operational excellence across the Global Player Support organization.
  

  

**PS****:\- This role involves a rotational shift (including US/Night shift)**


**Benefits**
------------


**What we offer:**


* The opportunity to join our growing business at an exciting time.

Dynamic and entrepreneurial culture.  
*

**Side** is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. **Founded in 2009 and drawing on 30\+ years' experience** from our parent company in Japan, Side has since grown to become a global force with **15\+ studios** in **over a dozen countries** across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia.
Our industry\-leading services include game development, art production, audio production, quality assurance, localization, localization QA, player support, community management, and datasets.


Help us bring stories to the world! Join a global team of passionate gamers and contribute to delivering unforgettable game experiences.

 Heritage Aviation Private Limited, approved by the Ministry of Civil Aviation, Government of India, provides premium aircraft and helicopter services across India and select international routes. title: Embedded Software Design Engineer
description:
Embedded Software Design Engineer:

We are looking for a passionate Embedded Software Design Engineer (fresher to 3 years of experience) to join our software team. You will develop firmware, device drivers, board support packages and application software for our GNSS receivers, time synchronization systems, antenna control units and rugged computing products, working closely with the hardware team from board bring\-up to field deployment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop firmware in Embedded C/C\+\+ for ARM Cortex\-M/Cortex\-A based microcontrollers and SoCs.
* Develop and port Board Support Packages (BSP), bootloaders (U\-Boot) and device drivers on Embedded Linux and RTOS platforms (FreeRTOS or equivalent).
* Implement drivers and application software for peripherals and interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet, USB, RS\-232/422/485 and GPIO.
* Develop and integrate communication protocols including TCP/IP, UDP, NTP/PTP time synchronization and NMEA/GNSS message parsing.
* Support board bring\-up of new hardware — flashing, debugging and validating processor, memory and peripheral functionality along with the hardware team.
* Implement algorithms for navigation, tracking and control applications in coordination with senior engineers.
* Write test code, perform unit and integration testing, and support environmental/EMI qualification test cycles.
* Debug issues at the hardware\-software boundary using JTAG debuggers, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.
* Prepare software design documents, test reports and user documentation.

**Required Skills:** 

* Strong programming fundamentals in C (and preferably C\+\+), data structures and memory management.
* Good understanding of microcontroller/microprocessor architecture, interrupts, timers, DMA and peripheral interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN).
* Basic knowledge of Embedded Linux or any RTOS concepts (tasks, scheduling, semaphores, queues).
* Familiarity with development tools: GCC toolchains, Makefiles, Git, JTAG/SWD debuggers.
* Ability to read schematics and datasheets and work closely with hardware engineers.
* Good analytical, debugging and documentation skills.
* For experienced candidates (1–3 yrs): hands\-on project experience in firmware/driver/BSP development is expected.

**Preferred / Added Advantage:**

* Academic or project exposure to GNSS/GPS, navigation, SATCOM or communication systems.
* Knowledge of Linux kernel/device driver development or Yocto build systems.
* Exposure to networking protocols (TCP/IP stack, NTP/PTP) or socket programming.
* Scripting knowledge (Python/Shell) for test automation.
* Familiarity with defense/aerospace software practices and documentation.

**What We Offer:** 

* Hands\-on exposure to complete product development — firmware to field deployment — on mission\-critical defense and aerospace products.
* Mentorship from a core team of experienced professionals across specialized domains.
* Fast learning curve in a DeepTech environment serving leading Indian PSUs and defense organizations.

description:
**RTL / Verilog Design Engineer (FPGA) :** 

We are seeking an RTL / Verilog Design Engineer (fresher to 3 years of experience) to develop FPGA\-based digital logic for our signal processing, navigation, timing and control products. You will design, simulate, verify and implement RTL for high\-pin\-count FPGAs used in GNSS receivers, beacon receivers, time servers and antenna control systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop RTL modules in Verilog/VHDL for FPGA\-based products — interface controllers, timing logic, data acquisition and signal processing blocks.
* Develop testbenches and perform functional simulation and verification of RTL designs (ModelSim/Vivado Simulator/Questa).
* Perform synthesis, place\-and\-route, timing constraint definition (SDC/XDC) and timing closure on Xilinx/Intel FPGA platforms (Vivado/Quartus).
* Implement and integrate interface logic such as UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, memory controllers (DDR), Ethernet MAC and high\-speed serial interfaces.
* Integrate and validate soft processor cores (MicroBlaze/NIOS) and IP cores, and support hardware\-software co\-design with the firmware team.
* Support FPGA board bring\-up and hardware validation using ChipScope/ILA, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.
* Develop DSP blocks (filters, correlators, NCOs, mixers) for GNSS/beacon signal processing applications under guidance of senior engineers.
* Document design architecture, verification plans, test reports and release notes.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong fundamentals in digital design — combinational/sequential logic, FSMs, FIFOs, clock domain crossing and pipelining.
* Good hands\-on knowledge of Verilog (or VHDL) coding for synthesis and simulation.
* Familiarity with FPGA design flow: simulation, synthesis, implementation, constraints and timing analysis.
* Exposure to Xilinx Vivado or Intel Quartus toolchains.
* Understanding of common peripheral interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C) and memory basics.
* Ability to write testbenches and debug simulation waveforms.
* Good problem\-solving, analytical and documentation skills.
* For experienced candidates (1–3 yrs): project experience in FPGA implementation, timing closure and board\-level validation is expected.

**Preferred / Added Advantage:**

* Academic or project exposure to DSP concepts (FIR/IIR filters, FFT, correlation) or SDR/GNSS signal processing.
* Knowledge of AXI/AVALON bus protocols and SoC FPGA platforms (Zynq).
* Exposure to high\-speed interfaces (PCIe, SerDes, Gigabit Ethernet) or DDR memory controllers.
* Familiarity with SystemVerilog or UVM\-based verification.
* Scripting skills (TCL, Python) for build and test automation.

**What We Offer:**

* Opportunity to work on FPGA designs at the heart of mission\-critical defense, SATCOM and navigation products.
* Complete design\-cycle exposure — RTL to silicon\-on\-board validation and field qualification.
* Mentorship from an experienced core team in a fast\-growing DeepTech company serving leading Indian PSUs and defense organizations.

The Quality Control (QC) Executive is responsible for ensuring that all cleaned plates, bowls, glasses, cutlery, serving utensils, crates, and other reusable food\-service items meet the company's quality, hygiene, and customer standards before dispatch. The role involves inspecting products at every stage of the washing, drying, sorting, packing, and dispatch process to ensure zero\-defect deliveries and maximum customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Quality Inspection**

* Inspect all washed plates, bowls, glasses, cutlery, trays, serving utensils, and containers before packing.
* Ensure items are completely free from:
* Food residue
* Oil and grease
* Water marks
* Stains
* Soap or detergent residue
* Odor
* Dust or contamination
* Reject chipped, cracked, broken, bent, rusted, or damaged items.
* Verify that all items meet company quality standards before approval.

**2\. Dispatch Verification**

* Verify customer\-wise packing quantities before dispatch.
* Ensure correct plate sizes, cutlery types, serving utensils, and accessories are packed according to the dispatch list.
* Cross\-check dispatch against customer orders.
* Prevent shortages, excess quantities, or wrong item dispatches.

**3\. Process Monitoring**

* Monitor washing, rinsing, drying, sorting, and packing activities.
* Ensure Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are followed at every stage.
* Conduct random in\-process quality inspections during production.
* Ensure rejected items are not mixed with approved inventory.

**4\. Hygiene \& Food Safety**

* Maintain high hygiene standards in washing, drying, inspection, and packing areas.
* Ensure employees follow personal hygiene requirements, including gloves, uniforms, masks, hairnets, and hand\-washing procedures.
* Verify proper storage of cleaned utensils to prevent contamination.
* Report any hygiene or sanitation violations immediately.

**5\. Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain Daily QC Inspection Reports.
* Record rejection quantities and rejection reasons.
* Prepare Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) reports.
* Maintain customer complaint records.
* Report recurring quality issues to the Operations Manager.

**6\. Continuous Improvement**

* Identify root causes of quality failures.
* Recommend improvements in washing, drying, handling, and packing processes.
* Assist in reducing customer complaints and product rejections.
* Participate in quality improvement initiatives and internal audits.

Authority

The QC Executive has the authority to:

* Stop dispatch of non\-conforming materials.
* Reject damaged or improperly cleaned utensils.
* Recommend rewash or rework of rejected items.
* Escalate repeated quality issues to management.
* Request corrective actions from Operations or Washing teams.

Required Skills

* Excellent attention to detail.
* Strong observation and inspection skills.
* Basic knowledge of hygiene, sanitation, and food safety practices.
* Ability to identify quality defects quickly.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Basic documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced operational environment.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making ability.

Qualifications

* Minimum: 12th Pass.
* Graduate or Diploma in Hospitality, Food Technology, Quality, or Operations is preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in Quality Control, Hospitality, Housekeeping, Laundry, Food Processing, Catering, Warehousing, or Manufacturing.
* Freshers with strong learning ability and discipline may also be considered.

Preferred Qualities

* Responsible and disciplined.
* Honest and dependable.
* Positive attitude.
* High level of integrity.
* Team player.
* Punctual and reliable.
* Ability to maintain consistent quality standards.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* 100% inspection of all dispatch materials.
* Zero dispatch of dirty or damaged items.
* Reduction in customer quality complaints.
* Reduction in rejected or returned materials.
* 100% compliance with SOPs and hygiene standards.
* Dispatch quantity accuracy above 99\.5%.
* Timely reporting of quality issues.
* Reduction in rewash and rework percentage.
* CAPA closure within defined timelines.

Working Conditions

* Work in a plate washing and sanitation facility.
* Standing and walking for extended periods.
* Exposure to wet work areas and cleaning chemicals.
* Rotational shifts, including weekends and holidays, as required.
* Mandatory use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

 We are growing our product team and hiring an APM who owns products end to end, from discovery to launch to adoption. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role for someone early in their product career who is deeply AI\-native, fluent in how modern AI products are built, comfortable with data, and hungry to own real outcomes.
   

 You will not just push work through a board. You will own the full software development lifecycle for your area and be accountable for what actually ships and gets adopted. This is a state\-of\-the\-art, AI\-first product role, with modern tooling and real ownership from day one.
   

  

**How our product team works**
 We are building a modern, AI\-native product team, and we want this to be a place where you do the best work of your career so far. A few things you can expect here:
 * Clear communication: We keep our thinking, decisions, and requirements well\-structured and easy to follow across product, engineering, and stakeholders
* Purposeful scope: We align early on a clear MVP and treat new ideas as deliberate next steps, so your work stays focused and actually ships
* Real ownership: You carry initiatives across the full lifecycle and are recognized for the outcomes and adoption they drive
* Building in the open: Prototypes and early check\-ins keep stakeholders close, so feedback shapes the work well before launch
* Close to the customer: Real client conversations and honest data guide what we build
* AI at the core: We build AI\-powered products and we build with AI, from agentic workflows to evaluations, and we keep pace with a fast\-moving field


**What you will do** 
* Own the full product lifecycle for your area: discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and adoption. You will start with our client onboarding and website\-building experience, and grow into our reputation and social products as you ramp
* Speak regularly with our US\-based clients (Voice of Customer): run interviews and conversations, and turn what you hear, alongside usage and adoption data, into product decisions
* Write clear, testable user stories and acceptance criteria, and shape and prioritize the backlog
* Own the user experience: UI, data, and front and back\-end interactions
* Lock the MVP and hold scope. Changes after lock become new, prioritized work, not silent scope creep
* Build working prototypes with AI tools, then hand a precise spec to engineering (engineering owns high\-level design and architecture)
* Partner closely with AI and full\-stack engineers, data, and design; keep stakeholders in the loop early and follow up so nothing goes stale
* Keep measurement honest and maintain evaluation sets for AI features
* Own the feedback loop for our internal tools: run a regular pulse with the internal teams who use them and turn what you hear into prioritized product work
* Drive each iteration and the launch, tracking against user needs and adoption
* After launch, monitor success metrics through proper dashboards, and use those results to define future enhancements or revisit the work as needed


**AI knowledge we expect** 
* A strong, practical grasp of how modern AI products work: large language models, prompting and context engineering, retrieval (RAG), knowledge graphs, and agents with tool use
* Evaluations as a first\-class habit: you can design and run evals and benchmarks for AI features, and reason clearly about quality, safety, and hallucination
* AI across your workflow: you use AI for research, prototyping, analysis, and writing, and build working prototypes independently in tools like Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, etc
* Genuine curiosity about a fast\-moving field: you keep pace with new models, tools, and patterns and bring the best of them into how we build


**What we require** 
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Data, or a related field
* 1\-3 years in product, product ownership, business or data analysis, or a closely related role
* Demonstrated understanding of AI/ML products, data, and the full software development lifecycle
* Excellent, fluent communication skills, written and verbal, and comfortable speaking directly with US\-based clients and stakeholders
* Hands\-on with Agile; can run grooming and planning without hand\-holding
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; comfortable with data (spreadsheets and SQL)
* High ownership: able to drive a feature from idea to adoption with minimal supervision


**How We Expect You to Work** 
* You reach for AI naturally to move faster, prototype, and explore ideas
* You take ownership and follow through, closing the loop on what matters
* You are curious and adaptable, and you thrive in a fast\-moving, modern environment
* You make decisions quickly and keep learning as the field evolves

description:
**We are one of the leading \& trusted manufacturers of a range of precision quality Testing Machines for Textile, Pharmaceutical \& Food Industries, since 2009 across India \& other countries. You can find more about us here: https://www.appleelectroniks.com**

**Role : FRESHER DIPLOMA / ITI Electrical Engineer – For Machine Manufacturing Industry**

**LOCATION : Vadodara, Gujarat**

**REPORTING TO : Production Manager/Service Manager**

**Job Overview**:

We are seeking a **dynamic young Electrical Engineer** **FRESHER** or with **1\-2 years of hands\-on experience** in the **machine manufacturing industry**. The ideal candidate will be responsible for **panel wiring, testing, machine assembly, trials, fitment, and Final QC Testing before dispatch** of machinery both within India and abroad.

**Key Responsibilities**:

* **Panel Wiring \& Assembly:** Perform electrical wiring and setup for control panels as per the circuit diagrams and technical drawings.
* **Machine Testing \& Trials:** Conduct pre\-delivery tests and trials to ensure the machine functions according to specifications.
* **Machine Assembly \& Fitment:** Assemble and fit electrical parts, PLC \& HMI, Servo Motor, Sensors \& Switch etc into machines while following industry standards and safety protocols.
* **Troubleshooting \& Maintenance:** Diagnose and rectify any electrical faults during machine trials Quality Checking stages or installation phases.
* **Compliance with Standards:** Ensure all electrical work complies with regulatory safety standards and customer\-specific requirements.
* **Documentation \& Reporting:** Maintain records of installations, testing results, and wiring layouts; provide reports post\-installation.
* **Client Interaction:** Coordinate with customers during installation to understand their requirements and provide technical guidance.
* **Team Collaboration:** Work closely with mechanical engineers, Design Team, production teams, and technical support staff for seamless project execution.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**:

* **Experience: 1\-2 years of hands\-on experience in electrical work within the machine manufacturing industry.**
* **Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with panel wiring, PLCs, HMIs, and electrical control systems. Experience with Fatek make PLC FBS Series and Kinco HMI is an advantage.**
* **Blueprint Reading: Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, technical drawings, and wiring diagrams \& Preparing Operational Manuals etc.**
* **Problem\-Solving Skills: Strong analytical skills to troubleshoot and resolve electrical issues quickly.**
* **Installation Expertise: Experience in handling on\-site installation and machine commissioning processes.**
* **Communication Skills: Effective verbal and written communication in Gujarati \& English, Hindi, and other regional languages as required.**
* **Travel Readiness: Willingness to travel extensively across India and abroad for project installations and support.**.

**Preferred Qualifications**:

* **Education**: Diploma/ITI in **Electrical Engineering** or a related field.
* **Software Skills**: Knowledge of **PLC programming** and basic automation software is a plus.

**Compensation \& Benefits**:

* **Salary**: Competitive, based on industry standards and experience.
* **Perks**: Travel allowances, project\-based incentives, and on\-site benefits.
* **Growth Opportunities**: Exposure to international projects with career advancement potential.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹14,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Are your confident to do Panel wiring, Assembly \& Testing Trails of Manufactured Instrument, Quality Checking of Servo, PLC, VFD, Sensors or any device related to Electrical

* Diploma (Required)

Experience:

* Panel Wiring: 1 year (Required)
* total work: 2 years (Preferred)
* Panel wiring, Assembly \& Testing Trails: 1 year (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 50% (Preferred)

title: Automobile Trainer for Krishnagar
description:
**Automobile Trainer**

Department

Training / Academics

Reports To

Academic Coordinator / Training Manager / Principal

Job Summary

The Automobile Trainer is responsible for delivering theoretical and practical training in automobile technology, vehicle maintenance, diagnostics, and repair. The trainer will equip students with industry\-relevant knowledge and hands\-on skills in automotive systems, ensuring they are prepared for employment in the automobile service and manufacturing sectors.

Key Responsibilities

* Deliver classroom lectures and practical training in automobile engineering and vehicle maintenance.
* Train students in the operation, servicing, maintenance, and repair of two\-wheelers, four\-wheelers, and commercial vehicles, as applicable.
* Teach automotive systems including engine, transmission, clutch, suspension, steering, braking, electrical, electronic, fuel injection, emission control, and HVAC systems.
* Demonstrate the use of automotive diagnostic tools, workshop equipment, and service manuals.
* Conduct practical sessions on engine overhaul, preventive maintenance, fault diagnosis, and vehicle inspection.
* Prepare lesson plans, practical manuals, presentations, assignments, and assessment materials.
* Evaluate students through theory tests, practical examinations, projects, and workshop performance.
* Ensure proper maintenance and safe operation of workshop tools, machinery, and equipment.
* Enforce workplace safety practices, PPE usage, and environmental standards in the workshop.
* Keep abreast of emerging automotive technologies, including electric vehicles (EVs), hybrid vehicles, advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), and automotive electronics.
* Mentor students during industrial visits, internships, projects, and placement activities.
* Maintain student records, attendance, assessment reports, and workshop inventory.
* Participate in curriculum development, faculty development programs, and institutional quality initiatives.

Required Qualifications

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Automobile Engineering, Mechanical Engineering (with Automobile specialization), or equivalent.
* ITI in Motor Mechanic Vehicle (MMV) with substantial industry/training experience may also be considered.
* Relevant certifications from automotive manufacturers or skill development agencies are desirable.

Required SkillsTechnical Skills

* Automobile engine systems
* Transmission and drivetrain systems
* Steering, suspension, and braking systems
* Automotive electrical and electronic systems
* Fuel injection and emission control systems
* Vehicle diagnostics using OBD scanners and diagnostic equipment
* Preventive maintenance and repair techniques
* Workshop tools, equipment, and safety procedures
* Knowledge of Electric Vehicles (EVs), Hybrid Vehicles, and Automotive Electronics
* Computer literacy and preparation of technical documentation

Soft Skills

* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Strong practical demonstration and training abilities
* Classroom and workshop management
* Problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Leadership and mentoring capabilities
* Teamwork and collaboration
* Time management and organizational skills
* Commitment to continuous learning and professional development

Experience

* **Freshers** with strong technical knowledge and practical skills may be considered.
* **1–5 years** of experience in automobile servicing, manufacturing, or technical training is preferred.
* Experience in vocational education, industrial training, or automotive service centers will be an added advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Student attendance and participation
* Student practical competency and assessment results
* Timely completion of syllabus and practical modules
* Workshop safety and equipment maintenance
* Student certification and placement outcomes
* Student feedback and satisfaction
* Industry engagement through projects, internships, and workshops
* Compliance with institutional policies and quality standards

Working Conditions

* Classroom and automobile workshop\-based training.
* Regular hands\-on practical sessions using vehicles, engines, and diagnostic equipment.
* May involve online, offline, and hybrid training modes.
* Participation in examinations, industrial visits, workshops, faculty development programs, and institutional events.

Preferred Attributes

* Passion for teaching and mentoring aspiring automobile technicians.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in vehicle maintenance and diagnostics.
* Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and practical manner.
* Awareness of the latest automotive industry trends and technologies.
* Commitment to safety, quality, and continuous professional development.

Pay: ₹9,434\.28 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Frontend Developer
description:
**About Ripik.AI**
 Ripik.AI is an Accel\-backed Applied AI company building computer vision and process\-optimisation agents for the world's largest industrial enterprises across steel, cement, aluminium, chemicals, pharma, and power. Our Vision AI platform acts as an automated pair of eyes on the shop floor — monitoring materials, equipment, and processes 24/7 with 95%\+ accuracy, eliminating human error, and delivering measurable gains in throughput, yield, energy efficiency, and safety.
   

  

 We work with marquee customers including Tata Steel, JSW, ArcelorMittal, Vedanta, Godrej \& Boyce, Grasim, Holcim, and Jindal Steel, and are scaling globally across India, the Middle East, Europe, and North America. As we move into our next phase of growth, we are building the operating backbone that will take Ripik from a high\-velocity scale\-up to a category\-defining global industrial AI company.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Frontend Developer at Ripik.AI, you'll build the interfaces that turn real\-time AI into decisions people can act on — dashboards used by plant operators every day, CXO views that shape multi\-million\-dollar decisions, and workflows that make heavy\-industry teams faster and safer.
   

  

 You'll work in React.js and modern frontend tooling, partner with backend engineers, designers, and product to ship features end\-to\-end, and care deeply about the details — performance, accessibility, loading states, empty states, and the feel of every interaction.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build production frontend features in React.js — from wireframes and design specs to shipped code that runs 24/7 in customer plants.
* Write clean, testable, maintainable code — components that other engineers can read, extend, and trust.
* Partner with backend engineers on REST API contracts — versioning, error handling, loading and empty states, and edge cases.
* Collaborate with designers on interaction, layout, and visual polish — you care about the difference between a shipped product and a designed product.
* Own the details — responsiveness, accessibility, performance, error handling, and the small interactions that make users trust the product.
* Debug production issues on live customer deployments — trace the bug from symptom to root cause, ship the fix, and prevent recurrence.
* Contribute to the design system — reusable components, patterns, and standards that future engineers and products build on.
* Grow with the team — take feedback in code review, learn from senior engineers, and raise your craft steadily over time.


**What You Bring**
* 1–5 years of hands\-on frontend engineering experience.
* Strong React.js — hooks, component design, state management, rendering behaviour.
* Solid JavaScript fundamentals — modern ES6\+, async/await, promises, closures.
* Strong HTML and CSS — semantic markup, flexbox, grid, responsive design, accessibility basics.
* Comfortable working with REST APIs — request/response, error handling, loading and empty states.
* Familiarity with modern frontend tooling — Vite, Webpack, npm/yarn, Git.
* Design sensibility — you notice the difference between good and great UI.
* Ownership mindset — you don't wait for tickets. You see a bug, you fix it. You see a gap, you flag it.


**What You Get**
* Build production interfaces used inside some of India's largest industrial plants — Tata Steel, JSW, Vedanta, and others.
* Direct partnership with senior engineers, designers, and product leaders from IIT Delhi, BITS, Google, IBM, and McKinsey.
* A clear growth path — SDE\-I to SDE\-II to SDE\-III and beyond, with real feedback loops and mentorship.
* World\-class engineering culture — code review, design docs, and clean architecture as defaults.
* A team that cares about craft — animations, empty states, edge cases, and the details that separate good from world\-class.
* A front\-row seat to how a category\-defining industrial AI company is built.


**Nice to Have**
* TypeScript experience — strong types, generics, and comfortable refactoring untyped code into typed.
* State management libraries — Redux, Zustand, React Query, or similar.
* Data visualisation experience — Recharts, D3, Chart.js, or comparable libraries for real\-time dashboards.
* Testing frameworks — Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright.
* Design tool fluency — Figma, working closely with designers on specs, prototypes, and design systems.
* Performance optimisation — code\-splitting, lazy loading, memoisation, bundle analysis.
* Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio of frontend projects we can look at.
* Exposure to AI/ML products — building interfaces for chat, agents, data exploration, or real\-time streams.

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
**About Patra**




  





 Patra is an outcome\-focused operating partner working exclusively for the insurance industry. Combining expert global teams, process intelligence, and purpose\-built technology, Patra delivers measurable results to clients. With 20 years of deep domain expertise, exceptional client retention rates, and significant sustained investment in AI, Patra partners with agencies, brokers, MGAs, MGUs, and carriers to transform how insurance operations are delivered.
 



  





**Position Summary**




 Patra is seeking a seasoned HR leader to serve as Head of HR for our operations in India. As the senior HRBP leader in the country, the Head of HR is the primary point of HR partnership for India\-based senior leaders, requiring a strong blend of business partnering skill and operational excellence, with a deep understanding of talent dynamics in a global delivery environment.
 



 This role leads the India HR Business Partner team, shares accountability of recruiting and total rewards outcomes in India with the US leaders of those functions, and ensures that the global HR strategy is executed with local rigor, compliance, and cultural fluency. The Head of HR will play a critical role in building a high\-performing HR team, strengthening operational leadership capabilities, and embedding a strong values\-driven culture aligned with global standards.
 



 Operating as a true business partner to India site and operations leadership, the Head of HR maintains tight alignment with the North America based global HR leader – to whom the role reports directly – while adapting global programs to the realities of the Indian market and regulatory environment. The role requires the ability to lead through influence in a global matrix, balancing country\-level HRBP ownership with joint accountability across functions.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Strategic HR Leadership** 



* Align HR strategies and plans with the business strategy, executing an India HR plan tied to global business and delivery objectives
* Execute the strategic direction set by global HR, including implementation of value\-added HR initiatives and programs that support business priorities
* Foster a high\-performance, client\-centric, and collaborative culture across the India organization
* Leverage HR policies, programs, and practices to create and maintain a positive, high\-performing workplace
* Leverage HR analytics to improve retention, utilization, and productivity; support, track, and report HR metrics as a means of measuring the effectiveness of our people practices
* Champion collaboration across the India HR team, and Patra Operations, Technology, and Compliance teams
* Proactively communicate with management in India to ensure appropriate collaboration on employee activities and processes
* Have a curiosity to dig into small issues before they become a problem



**HR Business Partnership and Leadership Advisory** 



* Provide leadership, advice, and counsel to senior leaders in India on human resources issues, serving as the primary HR point of contact for the country's leadership population
* Lead the regional HRBP organization and its key initiatives, ensuring consistent quality of partnership across sites and functions
* Act as leader of a high\-performing, collaborative HR team that mutually supports overall internal customer groups and each other
* Advise leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, leadership effectiveness, and change management tied to transformation initiatives
* Translate global HR strategy, policy, and programs into India execution, identifying local legal or cultural adaptations where required



**Employee Relations, Compliance, and Operations** 



* Advise senior management on the appropriate resolution of escalated employee relations issues; own employee relations for India, including investigations, disciplinary matters, POSH compliance, and grievance handling
* Educate supervisors and managers and monitor management actions and decisions to maintain legal and company policy compliance and values
* Partner with the Patra compliance function to ensure compliance with Indian labor laws and other statutory requirements, including PF, ESI, gratuity, shops and establishments, and contract labor regulations, with alignment to global HR governance
* Partner with HR Operations on HRIS adoption and data integrity for the India employee population



**Talent, Engagement, and Culture** 



* Identify and develop leadership talent for pipeline and succession planning, including building leadership pipelines for delivery heads
* Manage projects, programs, and practices that engage, inspire, and recognize workforce performance
* Drive engagement initiatives tailored to distributed Operations teams
* Partner with all HR functions, including Talent Acquisition, Learning and Development, Compensation, Benefits, and HR Operations, to deliver quality service



**Talent Acquisition (joint with NA TA leadership)** 



* Co\-accountability for India hiring outcomes, including volume, quality, time\-to\-fill, and cost\-per\-hire against operational demand
* Partner with the NA Talent Acquisition leader on recruiting strategy, employer brand in the India market, sourcing channels, and vendor management
* Ensure hiring plans remain synchronized with capacity planning and client ramp requirements



**Total Rewards (joint with NA Total Rewards leadership)** 



* Work with management and Total Rewards colleagues to ensure compensation and benefits are competitive and equitable, co\-owning India compensation and benefits strategy with attention to market competitiveness, internal equity, and cost discipline
* Provide India market intelligence on pay benchmarks, statutory benefits, and emerging practices to inform global rewards decisions
* Oversee execution of merit, promotion, and incentive cycles for the India population in line with the global calendar



**Global Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as the India voice in global HR forums and initiatives
* Bring global best practices into local execution
* Maintain tight operating rhythms with NA\-based HR leadership, with decision rights clearly documented across jointly owned functions



**Qualifications** 



* 10\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 8 years leading an HRBP team in India, ideally within BPO, ITES, technology services, or global shared services
* Demonstrated success operating in a global matrix, reporting into NA or other international HR leadership
* Deep expertise in Indian labor law, statutory compliance, and POSH
* Strong working knowledge of talent acquisition and compensation in the India market, including high\-volume hiring environments
* Experience with HR analytics and metrics\-driven decision making
* Experience supporting 24x7 or multi\-shift operations preferred
* Executive presence and the ability to influence senior operations leaders without direct authority
* Comfort with HR technology; Darwinbox experience a plus
* MBA or postgraduate degree in Human Resources preferred



  





 Patra Corporation is an equal opportunity employer committed to celebrating diversity and creating a safe and inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Associate - Onboarding
description:
**About CleanHarbors**
 Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $4\.3 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim, who today remains the company’s Chairman and CEO. Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on\-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.
   

  

 Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting\-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Job Title: Junior Associate or HR Associate, Employee Onboarding – HR Shared Services

You will be responsible for coordinating with various partner teams, recruiters, stakeholders \& Candidates to ensure efficient, compliant, timely onboarding of candidates and focus on providing exceptional candidate experience.
