description:
**Job Description**
**Purpose of the role**
 To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department's future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L \- Listen and be authentic, E \- Energise and inspire, A \- Align across the enterprise, D \- Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship \- our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset \- to Empower, Challenge and Drive \- the operating manual for how we behave.
   

  

 At Barclays, we don't just adapt to the future \- we create it. Embark on a transformative journey as part of the Business Analyst \- Finance Data Transformation, where you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring the resilience, scalability, and reliability of critical payment systems within the Merchant Services domain. You will be a key contributor championing quality and performance for systems that power merchant transactions, focusing on driving improvements in system stability, throughput, efficiency, and control.
   

  

 Working closely with Engineering teams and stakeholders across Finance Data Transformation team, you will help Engineering team deliver high\-performing solutions through agile delivery models.
   

  

 Leading the ongoing drive to enhance platform performance and reliability, you will champion a data\-driven and collaborative approach, ensuring that performance considerations are embedded throughout the software development lifecycle. Additionally, ensuring compliance with performance standards, risk controls, and service\-level expectations will be a key responsibility.
   

  

**To be successful as a Business Analyst, you should have experience with:**
* Experience in translating business and operational needs into succinct requirements, and associated analysis and design articulation methods.
* Experience across the full project lifecycle (from inception to closure) with strong knowledge of Agile methodologies.
* Understanding of the Finance or Risk data.
* Ability to use effective questioning techniques to identify, analyse and address underlying business needs.
* Strong understanding of risk management, control environments, and policy frameworks.
* Good understanding of Agile frameworks, including Scrum and Kanban.
* Experience with delivery workflow and articulation tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
* Strong MS Office skills, including advanced Excel (formulas, VLOOKUPs, macros), Word and PowerPoint.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include**
* Formal training in business analysis and change management.
* Understanding data integration concepts, including APIs and data transfer mechanisms.
* Familiarity with cloud\-based applications and platforms.
* Experience within the financial services industry.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The location of the role is Pune, IN.

description:

 The Engineer will be part of the Commerce Experiences team, responsible for delivering commerce experiences across Adobe products. * Work with senior engineers, architects, and product managers to understand requirements and translate them into well\-structured, testable UI code.

* Write unit and component\-level tests; participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality.

**What You'll Need To Succeed**

* Proficiency in modern JavaScript and at least one major framework — React preferred; familiarity with TypeScript or ES6\+ is a plus.
* Working knowledge of web standards and browser fundamentals — DOM, CSS (including SCSS), and debugging in modern browsers.
* Experience creating unit and component\-focused tests; exposure to integration or E2E testing is a bonus.
* Familiarity with Git and basic CI/CD workflows.
* Awareness of secure coding practices and frontend performance considerations.
* Comfort using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to write, test, and iterate on code within established standards.

**Nice to have**

 owning reliability, performance, and scale end to end. You will co\-drive your team's technical

 important, our platforms are increasingly intelligent: you will build and integrate LLM\-driven and
   

  

 agentic AI workflows into these systems, collaborating with product and business teams to

 strong systems engineer with solid AI experience \- someone who thinks deeply about data
   

  

 modeling, distributed systems, and what it takes to keep services fast and dependable under
   

  

 real\-world load, and who knows how to bring LLM\-powered capabilities into that world reliably.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What qualities are we looking for?**
* B Tech/M Tech in Computer Science or equivalent from a reputed college with a minimum of 3\-5 years of experience in a product development company.
* Proven experience designing and building distributed, high\-concurrency, low\-latency


 backend systems at scale.

 development, deployment, monitoring, and on\-call operations.
   

  

* Strong grasp of scalability fundamentals: caching, queuing/async processing, sharding and


 partitioning, replication, load balancing, rate limiting, and fault tolerance.
   

  

* Strong design skills involving data modeling, low\-level class design, API design, and


 system design.
   

  

* Good knowledge of object\-oriented programming, concurrency primitives, and design


 patterns.
   

  

* Proficiency in at least one programming language \- Python, Java, Golang.
* Hands\-on experience with relational and NoSQL databases, messaging systems (e.g.,


 Kafka, SQS), and Linux/Unix platforms.
   

  

* Follows industry coding standards and is responsible for writing maintainable, scalable,


 and efficient code to solve business problems.
   

  

* A strong team player who has mentored junior developers and helped raise the technical


 bar of the team.
   

  

* Hands\-on experience integrating LLMs from providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic


 (Claude), Bedrock, and Azure OpenAI into production systems.
   

  

* Practical experience with LangChain or LangGraph for building AI\-driven workflows and


 orchestration; exposure to agentic/multi\-agent architectures preferred.
   

  

* Strong technical aptitude and good knowledge of CS fundamentals.


**What will you get to do here?**
* Architect and build new backend services from the ground up, and evolve existing systems for higher scale, concurrency, and reliability.
* Own end\-to\-end architecture for your team's systems and implement the long\-term


 technology vision for your team.
   

  

* Come up with best practices to help the team achieve their technical tasks and continually


 improve the technology of the product/team.
   

  

* Drive the adoption of best practices through regular participation in code reviews, design


 reviews, and architecture discussions.
   

  

* Mentor and guide developers on the team through design feedback, pairing, and code


 reviews.
   

  

* Design and ship AI\-driven and agentic workflows within your services, and experiment with


 new and relevant technologies and tools, driving adoption while measuring yourself on the
   

  

 impact you create.
   

  

* Decide technology and tool choices for your team and be responsible for them.

 B Tech/M Tech in Computer Science or equivalent from a reputed college with minimum 3 – 5 years of experience in product development company.

* Use AI\-assisted development tools as part of your everyday workflow, and take ownership of your work end to end, writing tests, maintaining documentation, and participating in code reviews and engineering decisions.

* Build and support AI feature development across the stack, including services that expose ML model outputs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and agentic AI workflows that connect intelligence to real\-world industrial systems.


**The Essentials \- You Will Have**
* 2\+ years of experience in a backend\-focused role.

* Practical experience working across Windows and Linux environments.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**WHO YOU ARE** 




  





 We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our dynamic team, dedicated to advancing IKEA's digital infrastructure and capabilities. In this role, you will be responsible for building, deploying, and maintaining web applications. They bridge the gap between development and operations teams by automating workflows and ensuring a smooth development lifecycle.
   

 We expect you to be tech agnostic. You should feel comfortable working with a variety of technologies. Experience with cloud\-native app development on GCP – you have a good understanding of cloud storage, databases, serverless and you understand how to use cloud\-native in production.
   

 The IKEA culture and values are very much a part of our business and day to day work life. For you to thrive and grow with IKEA it’s important for us that you share our values! You can read more regarding our values and life at IKEA on our website www.ikea.com.
   

  

 • Proven experience in Frontend development with clean, efficient, and well\-documented code using various languages including Typescript and Python.
   

 • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as BigQuery, CloudSQL, and Pub/Sub, or similar cloud\-based data processing technologies.
   

 • Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in application development, integrations, data engineering, such as Python, and experience with related frameworks and libraries.
   

 • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and experience with relational databases.
   

 • Understanding how to manage complex state in a front\-end application
   

 • Familiarity with DevOps practices for continuous integration and deployment of data pipelines, including version control systems like Git.
   

 • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams to understand data requirements and deliver solutions that meet business objectives.
   

 • Alignment with IKEA's values and vision of creating a better everyday life for the many people, with a passion for leveraging data to drive positive change.
   

  

 This is our wish list! If you don’t recognize yourself in all these points, you might still be an excellent candidate for the role.
   

  

 The must\-haves we see for this role is though:
   

 • Formal qualifications in computer science, software engineering, or an equivalent engineering discipline
   

 • Minimum 5 years of experience as a software engineer, data engineer, or equivalent, working in agile and iterative teams
   

 • Absolute understanding of Git (branching, merging, rebasing, pull requests) and platforms like GitHub or GitLab.
   

 • Strong programming and data manipulation skills using Typescript, Nodejs/Python and advanced SQL
   

 • Familiarity with at least one of the databases –PostgreSQL, BigQuery.
   

 • Familiarity with at least one of the databases Firestore, MongoDB and Elasticsearch
   

 • Proven experience building system REST APIs or Graphql undestanding
   

 Good to Have
   

 • Knowing how to set up automated testing and deployment pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions)
   

 • Knowledge of caching using Redis or Memcache.
   

 • Experience with frameworks like Django, FastAPI for backend and React/Angular for Frontend
   

 • Expeirence with Graph databases like Neo4j
   

 • Experience around analytics tools like Power BI/Looker/Apache SuperSet
   

 • Experience with authentication and Authorization protocols (Oauth/Jwt)
 



  





**A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US** 




  





 You’ll be a vital part in the transformation of IKEA into a more front line obsessed company by ensuring that we constantly understand what our co\-workers are telling us.
   

 This mean that you will:
   

  

 Drive modern software engineering principles, utilization of proper tools and create a strong digital foundation for IKEAs Digital products and business.
   

 Other responsibilities:
   

 • Design, develop, and implement Typescript/Javascript, Python and SQL code with CI/CD pipelines on GCP using tools like Github Actions or Cloud Functions.
   

 • Manage infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or Cloud Deployment Manager.
   

 • Monitor application and infrastructure health and troubleshoot issues
   

 • Collaborating with stakeholders to understand requirements and develop solutions that address business needs.
   

 • Implementing best practices for reliability and performance optimization.
   

 • Contributing to the automation of data pipeline deployment and monitoring using DevOps practices and tools.
   

 • Participating in code reviews, knowledge sharing sessions, and continuous learning activities to enhance your skills and contribute to the team's success.
 



  





**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 




  





 We’re the ones who make it possible for people to have a smarter life at home and a hassle\-free and rewarding shopping experience. Together we work to find new digital solutions for every business need to help make IKEA a great and efficient place to work. We like to think of ourselves as innovative and modern, and we believe that nothing would actually work without us.

title: Software Engineer, Frontend/Fullstack
description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
 WisdomAI builds AI\-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
   

  

 We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
   

  

**This role**
 Backed by Wisdom's adaptive context layer, at the core is generative UI: the charts, dashboards, and insights are generated, not built screen by screen. And it runs wherever people already are: web, mobile, Slack or embedded within their web app. The problems are hard, the UX has no playbook!
   

  

 You own a user\-facing surface end to end and sweat how it feels. We're hiring at the mid to senior level, with room for staff engineers who still love to build.
   

  

 How we work
   

  

**Builders:** 
 You're a frontend engineer at heart. Some of us run 50/50 frontend and backend. Some stay frontend\-heavy on the hard UI and visualization work. We build the role around you.
   

  

**Ownership** 
 :Engineers own projects here, from requirements to ship. PMs and designers are partners and input, not a queue you wait behind. Wherever the work starts, we build it – together.
   

  

**Proximity:** 
 You'll work closely with customers, through sales and support and as directly as you want. Staying close is how any of us build something people love to use.
   

  

**Judgement:** 
 We all work across the stack with AI doing a lot of the typing. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, pick your flavor, most of us use all three. So the job isn't typing anymore. It's taste and judgment about what's worth building and whether it's any good.
   

  

**Fluidity:** 
 The work spans three teams: Dashboard \& Visualization, Chat \& Context, and Agents \& Integrations. You'll land where you fit and where the work is, and move between them as the product grows.
   

  

 What you'd work on
   

  

 A few of the problems open right now:
   

  

* Generating code that produces visualizations good enough to ship: charts, and dense P\&L tables where every number and pixel has to land. Two hard parts. The data transforms that turn raw rows into a real financial statement, and chart specs that come out looking like a pro built them, without latency growing as the visual gets more complex.
* Designing the edit experience for AI\-generated visuals, where typing a follow\-up and reaching for a knob should feel like the same product. Live\-preview controls only work if the visual comes out parameterized in the first place, with the knobs UI built from those parameters.
* Streaming a chat agent's thinking as a trace you can click into, so a business user can watch what it did and open any step while it's still running. The trick is turning a messy pile of tool calls into something that reads like a sentence. It should earn trust in the answer and still get out of the way of the result.
* Building the React SDK other data teams build on, to drop in dashboards and chat or assemble something of their own with WisdomAI underneath. It lives or dies on the abstraction: the APIs, the docs, the examples that make building on us feel easy instead of like a fight.


 You may be a good fit if you
   

  

* Ship with React, TypeScript, and Node, and obsess over the polish and the details
* Have product instinct: you can take a fuzzy customer pain and decide what's worth building
* Run on high agency, you find the work and drive it instead of waiting for a ticket
* Want customers close enough that they shape what you build
* Have a Bachelor's in Computer Science or equivalent


 Strong candidates may also have
   

  

* Data viz, BI, GenUI or dashboarding experience
* A real eye for design and polish
* Time at an early\-stage or founding team


 Not sure this is the right fit?
   

  

* Backend engineer at heart who'll happily dip into UI when needed? Check out Software Engineer, Backend @ WisdomAI
* Design engineer who wants to live in design systems, Figma, and interaction craft? Check out Design Engineer @ WisdomAI


**Our CRAFT**
 CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
   

  

**C — Customer trust.** 
 Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
   

  

**R — Relentless on outcomes.** 
 We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
   

  

**A — Authenticity.** 
 We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
   

  

**F — First principles, grounded in reality.** 
 We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real\-world results decide.
   

  

**T — Transparency.** 
 We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
   

  

**Equal opportunity employer**
 WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

 At project44,
 
**we believe in better.**

  
 

  
 





 We challenge the status quo because we know a better supply chain isn’t just possible—it’s essential. Better for our customers. Better for their business. Better for the world. 
 

  
 





 With our
 
**Decision Intelligence Platform,**
***Movement***
**,**

 we’re redefining how global supply chains operate. By transforming fragmented logistics data into real\-time, AI\-powered insights, we empower companies to connect instantly, see clearly, act decisively, and automate intelligently. Our Supply Chain AI enhances visibility, drives smarter execution, and unlocks next\-gen applications that keep businesses moving forward. 
 

  
 





 Headquartered in Chicago, IL with a 2nd HQ in Bengaluru, India we are powered by a diverse global team that is tackling the toughest logistics challenges with innovation, urgency, and purpose. 
 

  
 




**AI at project44**





 We expect every project44 team member, regardless of role or function, to actively leverage AI in their day\-to\-day work. Whether you're building product, serving customers, managing people, or running operations, AI is a tool you're expected to use with intent, curiosity, and judgment. We don't expect everyone to be a data scientist. We do expect everyone to be an intelligent user of AI: able to identify where it adds value, direct it effectively, evaluate outputs critically, and govern it responsibly. We invest in our team's AI fluency because we believe it's a competitive advantage for every person at project44, not just our engineers
 





 If you’re driven to solve meaningful problems, leverage AI to scale rapidly, drive impact daily, and be part of a high\-performance team – we should talk.
 


  
 





**Description:**

  
 

  
 





 project44 is looking for a
 
**Software Engineer \- Backend**

 to join our engineering team. You will work in a fast\-paced Agile environment designing, building, and implementing best\-in\-class integrations to accelerate how project44 connects to the world’s logistics networks.  
 

  
 






**Key accountabilities: What you'll work on**

  
 

  
 



* Build state\-of\-the\-art integrations to expand our ever\-growing network of connected carriers and customers.
* Manage integrations through their life cycle.
* Operate, maintain, and improve the supply chain visibility platform owned by the team.
* Building systems in a multi\-cloud environment. We use AWS and GCP but value experience in other cloud environments such as Azure.
* Work with and align with cross functional teams to solve challenging problems.
* Share ownership of all facets of software delivery, including development, operations, and test
* You will assume on\-call responsibilities for systems (together with the team) that are built and owned by your team.
* You will invest in tools, monitoring, and automation to improve on\-call experience for everyone on your team.




  
 
**Qualifications:**

  
 

  
 



* 2\-5 years professional experience building large scale and real time or near real time cloud systems.
* Strong programming and debugging skills, with proficiency in Java.




 Experience in:  
 

  
 



* Building systems in a multi\-cloud environment. We use AWS \& GCP but value experience in other cloud environments such as Azure.
* Creating and working with scalable Java\-based micro\-services.
* Working with databases (preferably Postgres or other SQL based DB)
* Event stores and stream\-processing in Kafka or Kinesis.
* Working in an agile software development environment.




 Desirable and helpful (but not necessary) are experience in  
 

  
 



* Experience with investigating large and complex codebases
* Creating API's/web services: REST, OpenAPI/Swagger is a plus.
* Container\-orchestration: Docker \& Kubernetes
* Enjoy database related work: DynamoDB, MongoDB, Postgres.
* Analytical approach to problem solving.
* Personal drive and maintaining a high pace \- while taking responsibility for things working.
* Willingness to vocalize your ideas and pick yourself up if you get knocked down.




**In\-office Commitment:**

 This position requires a commitment to contribute to our collaborative culture by working in\-office
 

**three** 
  days weekly.
 


  
 




**Diversity \& Inclusion**

  
 





 At project44, we're designing the future of how the world moves and is connected through trade and global supply chains. As we work to deliver a truly world\-class product and experience, we are also intentionally building teams that reflect the unique communities we serve. We’re focused on creating a company where all team members can bring their authentic selves to work every day.
 

  
 





 We’re building a company that every one of us at project44 is proud to work for, and our journey of becoming a more diverse, equitable and inclusive organization, where all have a sense of belonging, is shaped through the actions of our leadership, global teams, and individual team members. We are resolute in our belief that each team member has an equal responsibility to mold and uphold our culture.
 

  
 





 project44 is an equal opportunity employer seeking to enrich our work environment by creating opportunities for individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to thrive. If you share our values and our passion for helping the way the world moves, we’d love to review your application!
 

  
 





 For any accommodation needed during the hiring process, please email   recruiting@project44\.com. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above job description you should still seriously consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.
 

  
 




**More about project44**

  
 





 Since 2014, project44 has been transforming the way one of the largest, most important global industries does business. As transportation and logistics continue to evolve and customer expectations around delivery become more demanding, industry technology must rise to the occasion. In just a few short years, we have created a digital infrastructure that eliminates the inefficiencies caused by dated technology and manual processes. Our Advanced Visibility Platform is used by the world’s leading brands to track shipments, collaborate with supply chain partners, drive operational efficiencies, and create outstanding customer experiences.

description:
**About Eudia**
 Eudia is redefining the future of legal work with AI\-powered Augmented Intelligence, enabling Fortune 500 legal teams to move faster, manage risk more effectively, and unlock new business value. Backed by $105M in Series A funding led by General Catalyst, we’re building a category\-defining platform that blends AI\-driven automation with human expertise, transforming legal from a cost center into a strategic growth driver.
   

  

 At Eudia, we move fast. Unlike traditional enterprise software, our teams ship solutions in days, not months—delivering real impact for some of the world’s largest companies, including Cargill, Coherent, DHL, and Duracell. We’re solving one of the most complex, unsolved challenges in AI: bringing trust, accuracy, and security to legal automation.
   

  

 We’re a team of builders, operators, and problem\-solvers who are passionate about reshaping an industry that has long been resistant to change. If you’re looking for a place where you’ll be challenged, take ownership from day one, and work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI and legal —we’d love to meet you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you excited about shaping the future of AI\-driven legal solutions? We are looking for a
 **Frontend Engineer** 
 to help build next\-generation platforms that power agentic AI models for the legal industry. This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI, scalable infrastructure, and legal innovation, building intelligent systems that streamline workflows, enhance legal research, and automate complex decision\-making. It's a great opportunity to build enterprise\-grade resilient platforms and services that are backed by cutting edge generative ai based solutions for some of the big Fortune 500 companies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Technical Skills: Experience in frontend architecture, building complex web applications, ensuring responsiveness, accessibility, and performance across browsers and devices.
* Code Quality \& Best Practices: Must exhibit high coding standards, conduct code reviews, and ensure adherence to best practices within the development team.
* System Ownership: Taking full ownership of significant frontend modules, design systems, and UI platforms ensuring pixel\-perfect implementation and non\-functional excellence. Design and deliver resilient and extensible user interfaces.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Working closely with other engineering teams, including product managers, designers, and backend engineers to align on technical roadmaps and deliver impactful user experiences.
* Performance Optimization: Identifying and resolving rendering bottlenecks, optimizing bundle sizes, reducing load times, and ensuring smooth 60fps interactions across the application.
* Innovation and Development: Contributing to the evolution of the frontend stack and component library by implementing modern frameworks, design patterns, and emerging web platform capabilities.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's in Computer Science, Design Engineering, Human\-Computer Interaction, or a related field (Masters preferred).
* Strong Programming Skills: Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Next.js, Vue, Angular).
* Frontend Architecture: Deep understanding of client\-side architecture principles, including state management, rendering strategies (SSR/CSR/ISR), and micro\-frontend patterns.
* Tooling \& Infrastructure Expertise: Familiarity with modern build tools (Webpack, Vite, Turbopack), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (e.g., Vercel, AWS CloudFront) for frontend deployment and delivery.
* Problem\-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to diagnose complex UI/UX issues, cross\-browser quirks, and develop effective solutions.
* Communication and Collaboration: Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences, effectively collaborating with cross\-functional teams including designers and product stakeholders.


**Why You'll Love Working Here**
* Impactful Work: Be part of a team that's at the forefront of AI innovation.
* Growth Opportunities: Work in an environment that encourages professional growth and the exploration of new ideas.
* Dynamic Culture: Join a group of passionate, driven individuals who are committed to making a difference.


 If you're ready to take on the challenge and make an impact in a rapidly evolving industry, we want to hear from you!

description:
**Overview**
 Stats Perform is the market leader in sports tech.  We provide the most trusted sports data to some of the world's biggest organizations, across sports, media, and broadcasting.
   

  

 Through the latest AI technologies and machine learning, we combine decades' worth of data with the latest in\-game happenings. We then offer coaches, teams, professional bodies, and media channels around the world, access to the very best data, content, and insights.  In turn, improving how sports fans interact with their favourite sports teams and competitions.
   

  

**How do we add value?**
* Media outlets add a little magic to their coverage with our stats and graphics packages.
* Sportsbooks can offer better predictions and more accurate odds.
* The world's top coaches are known to use our data to make critical team decisions.
* Sports commentators can engage with fans on a deeper level, using our stories and insights.


 Anywhere you find sport, Stats Perform is there.  However, data and tech are only half of the package. We need great people to fuel the engine.
   

  

 We succeeded thanks to a team of amazing people. They spend their days collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data from a wide range of live sporting events. If you combine this real\-time data with our 40\-year\-old archives, elite journalists, camera operators, copywriters, the latest in AI wizardry, and a host of 'behind the scenes' support staff, you've got all the ingredients to make it a magical experience!
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Mission Statement: The HRBP acts as a strategic and operational HR leader for the India business, partnering with business leaders to align people strategy, workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, and employee engagement with company objectives. The role also leads the local HR Shared Services (HRSS) team, ensuring high\-quality HR operations, governance, employee support, and compliance with statutory and company standards.
* Business Impact: This role contributes directly to organizational performance through effective people partnership, leadership support, employee relations management, workforce governance, and delivery of scalable HR operations. The role supports talent retention, operational efficiency, compliance, and employee experience while ensuring alignment with global HR standards and business priorities.
* Decision\-making Authority: The role holds responsibility for advising and influencing leaders on workforce decisions, employee relations matters, organizational design, performance management, and HR governance within defined company policies and statutory frameworks. The position also oversees prioritization and execution of HRSS operational activities, escalates business risks where required, and drives alignment between local execution and global HR direction.


**Required Qualifications:**
* Operational Management: Oversee day\-to\-day HR operations and HR Shared Services delivery for the India population. Lead and manage a team of 4–5 HRSS employees, ensuring service quality, responsiveness, and operational efficiency. Ensure accurate employee lifecycle management, HR data governance, compliance, and documentation standards. Manage employee relations cases, disciplinary actions, grievances, and escalation handling.
* Strategic Execution: Partner with business and operational leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, succession planning, and talent initiatives. Drive performance management processes, leadership capability development, and retention initiatives. Support organizational change, restructuring, and transformation activities.
* Stakeholder Partnering: Act as trusted advisor to managers and senior business leaders across the India organization. Collaborate with global HR teams including Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Rewards, HR Operations, and Learning \& Development. Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on employee risk mitigation and governance matters.
* Service Delivery: Ensure timely and accurate resolution of HR queries, employee requests, and HR operational activities. Drive continuous improvement, process optimization, and operational efficiency initiatives.
* People Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the local HR Shared Services team. Drive accountability, prioritization, collaboration, and development within the team. Foster a high\-performance, compliant, and employee\-focused HR culture.
* Financial Responsibility and Revenue Impact: Supports workforce cost management, headcount governance, and organizational efficiency initiatives. Contributes to operational effectiveness through optimized HR processes and controlled people\-related risk management.


**Desired Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related discipline required. MBA or postgraduate HR qualification preferred.
* Significant progressive HR experience within HR Business Partnering and/ or HR Operations environments.
* Prior experience leading HR operational or HR Shared Services teams preferred.


**Why work at Stats Perform?**
**We love sports, but we love diverse thinking more!**
 We know that diversity brings creativity, so we invite people from all backgrounds to join us.  At Stats Perform you can make a difference, by using your skills and experience every day, you'll feel valued and respected for your contribution.
   

  

**We take care of our colleagues**
 We like happy and healthy colleagues. You will benefit from things like Mental Health Days Off, ‘No Meeting Fridays,’ and flexible working schedules.
   

  

**We pull together to build a better workplace and world for all.**
 We encourage employees to take part in charitable activities, utilize their 2 days of Volunteering Time Off, support our environmental efforts, and be actively involved in Employee Resource Groups.
   

  

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Stats Perform**
 By joining Stats Perform, you'll be part of a team that celebrates diversity. A team that is dedicated to creating an inclusive atmosphere where everyone feels valued and welcome. All employees are collectively responsible for developing and maintaining an inclusive environment. That is why our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion goals underpin our core values.
   

  

 With increased diversity comes increased innovation and creativity. Ensuring we're best placed to serve our clients and communities. Stats Perform is committed to seeking diversity, equity, and inclusion in all we do.

 **HR Executive / HR Generalist**

 Role Overview
 
 The HR Executive will support the complete employee lifecycle, including recruitment coordination, onboarding, employee documentation, attendance and leave administration, performance appraisal documentation, employee engagement, payroll inputs, separation formalities, and management reporting.
 



 This is a hands\-on HR operations role requiring strong ownership, confidentiality, accuracy, follow\-up, and coordination with employees, managers, department heads, and company management.
 


 Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment and Joining Coordination
 * Coordinate recruitment activities, including job postings, candidate screening, interview scheduling, follow\-ups, and maintaining recruitment records.
* Coordinate with hiring managers to understand open positions, required skills, experience, and joining timelines.
* Maintain updated candidate trackers and provide recruitment status reports to management.
* Prepare and issue offer letters, appointment letters, confidentiality agreements, and other pre\-employment documents.
* Follow up with selected candidates regarding document submission, notice periods, joining dates, and onboarding requirements.
* Conduct reference and background verification wherever required.


 Onboarding and Employee Documentation
 * Manage the complete onboarding process for new employees.
* Collect, verify, organize, and maintain employee documents and personnel files.
* Prepare employee codes, joining documentation, induction schedules, policy acknowledgements, and onboarding checklists.
* Coordinate with IT, Administration, Reporting Managers, and other departments for system access, assets, email creation, seating, and induction.
* Ensure that all mandatory joining formalities are completed within the defined timelines.
* Maintain accurate digital and physical employee records in the HRMS or ERP system.
* Monitor probation periods and coordinate confirmation reviews with reporting managers.


 HR Letters and Employee Lifecycle Documentation
 * Prepare and issue employment\-related letters, including:
* Offer letters
* Appointment letters
* Probation confirmation letters
* Salary revision letters
* Appraisal letters
* Promotion and designation\-change letters
* Transfer letters
* Warning and disciplinary letters
* Experience and relieving letters
* Full\-and\-final settlement documentation
* Ensure all letters are accurate, properly approved, issued on time, and securely maintained.
* Maintain templates and registers for all employee\-related communications and documents.


 Attendance, Leave and Payroll Support
 * Monitor employee attendance, leave, work\-from\-home records, late arrivals, regularization requests, and related HR transactions.
* Follow up with employees and managers for pending attendance or leave approvals.
* Prepare accurate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, leave, new joiners, exits, salary revisions, incentives, deductions, reimbursements, and other applicable components.
* Coordinate with the payroll or finance team to ensure timely and accurate salary processing.
* Review payroll\-related employee queries and coordinate their resolution.
* Maintain records related to statutory benefits, employee insurance, deductions, and other applicable benefits.


 Day\-to\-Day HR Operations
 
  




* Assist employees and managers with HR policies, attendance, leave, documentation, appraisal, benefits, and workplace procedures.
* Monitor pending HR activities and ensure timely closure through regular follow\-ups.
* Maintain employee master data, organizational information, reporting structures, and departmental records.
* Coordinate employee birthdays, work anniversaries, recognition activities, internal events, and engagement initiatives.
* Support disciplinary, grievance, performance improvement, and employee\-relations processes in coordination with management.
* Maintain confidentiality while handling employee information and sensitive organizational matters.
* Ensure HR policies and procedures are consistently followed across departments.


 Management Information and Reporting
 * Provide accurate employee and HR information to management whenever requested.
* Maintain updated HR dashboards and trackers covering recruitment, onboarding, attendance, leave, attrition, performance reviews, employee documentation, and pending HR actions.
* Submit a structured
 **bi\-weekly HR report** 
 to management.
* Highlight pending approvals, recruitment delays, documentation gaps, attendance concerns, employee issues, policy deviations, and other areas requiring management attention.
* Prepare monthly and ad\-hoc reports based on management requirements.
* Ensure that reports contain accurate information, clear observations, responsible owners, target dates, and recommended actions.


 Bi\-Weekly HR Report Coverage
 
 The bi\-weekly HR report should include:
 


* Current employee headcount
* New joiners and upcoming joiners
* Employees under probation
* Pending employee confirmations
* Open positions and recruitment status
* Offers issued, accepted, declined, or pending
* Employee exits and notice\-period status
* Pending onboarding documents
* Attendance and leave exceptions

  Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

  Full\-time 
 **Seniority:** 
  Associate / Mid\-level (2–6 years) 
 **Reporting to:** 
  Managing Director and CEO
 


 About us
 
 Anton Global Pharmaceuticals is a Mumbai\-based pharmaceutical export house. We move finished formulations, nutraceuticals and APIs into markets across Latin America, the Middle East and Africa. We are a lean team, which means every role here is hands\-on and visible.
 


 The role
 
 This is a two\-part role reporting directly to the Managing Director and the CEO. The first half is executive assistance to both principals — calendar, travel, correspondence, meeting preparation and follow\-through. The second is talent acquisition: finding candidates, running the hiring process end to end, and keeping our pipeline full as we grow.
 



 To be clear about scope: this is 
 **not** 
  an HR business\-partner or people\-management role, and it does not cover HR administration. You will not be running performance reviews, handling payroll or statutory paperwork, or sitting inside the operating workflow of the commercial and supply chain teams. Those functions sit elsewhere. Your mandate is to keep the MD's and CEO's day running on time, and to keep the hiring pipeline full.
 


 What you'll do
 
**Executive assistance to the MD and CEO** 



* Manage both calendars: scheduling, rescheduling, protecting focus time, and flagging conflicts before they happen.
* Plan and book domestic and international travel — flights, hotels, visas, forex, ground transport, itineraries.
* Prepare meeting material: agendas, briefing notes, background on the counterparty, and minutes with clear action points.
* Track follow\-ups and deadlines across both principals' commitments so nothing quietly lapses.
* Draft and manage correspondence, and act as the first point of contact for external visitors and callers.
* Handle expense reports, documentation filing, and confidential record\-keeping.



**Talent acquisition** 



* Own the hiring pipeline end to end: draft and post openings on LinkedIn, Naukri and other channels, and manage the applicant flow.
* Source actively rather than waiting on inbound — LinkedIn search, Naukri database, consultant channels, referrals.
* Screen CVs against the brief, run first\-round telephonic screening, and shortlist for the hiring manager.
* Coordinate interviews across the MD's and CEO's calendars, keep candidates warm, collect feedback, and close the loop with every applicant.
* Manage offer rollout, negotiation support, reference and background checks, and the joining handover.
* Maintain a live candidate database and a running pipeline report for the MD and CEO.
* Manage recruitment vendors: consultants, job portals, background\-check agencies.


 What we're looking for
 * 2–6 years of experience in an EA/executive support role, in recruitment or talent acquisition, or a mix of both. A mix is ideal.
* Demonstrable recruitment experience — you should be able to talk through roles you have actually closed.
* Strong written and spoken English; Hindi and Marathi useful for local hiring.
* Genuinely organised: you keep trackers, you follow up without being chased, and you close things out.
* Discreet. You will see salary data, commercial correspondence and the calendars of both principals.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets, LinkedIn Recruiter or Naukri, and standard scheduling and document tools.

* Experience hiring for pharma, chemicals, export or supply chain functions.
* Comfort working across Indian and Gulf time zones.

* A clearly defined mandate with no ambiguity about scope.
